mar-1.location: İstanbul, Türkiye · 土耳其伊斯坦布尔
mar-1.intro: The Historic Areas of Istanbul occupy the imperial peninsula between the Golden Horn, the Bosphorus and the Sea of Marmara. This UNESCO World Heritage property gathers the monuments of three imperial capitals — Byzantine Constantinople and Ottoman Istanbul above all — including Hagia Sophia, Topkapı Palace, the Blue Mosque, the Hippodrome and the Theodosian land walls. Its skyline of domes and minarets is one of the most recognisable in the world.
mar-1.introZh: 伊斯坦布尔历史区位于金角湾、博斯普鲁斯海峡与马尔马拉海之间的帝国半岛，是联合国教科文组织世界遗产。这里汇聚了拜占庭君士坦丁堡与奥斯曼伊斯坦布尔两大帝都的精华，包括圣索菲亚、托普卡帕宫、蓝色清真寺、古竞技场和狄奥多西城墙。层叠的穹顶与宣礼塔构成了世界上最易辨识的天际线之一。

mar-2.location: Sultanahmet, İstanbul, Türkiye · 土耳其伊斯坦布尔苏丹艾哈迈德
mar-2.intro: Hagia Sophia was built by Emperor Justinian between 532 and 537 and remained the world's largest cathedral for nearly a thousand years. Its vast central dome, hovering mosaic seraphim and luminous stonework changed the history of architecture. After serving as a church, a mosque, a museum and again a mosque since 2020, it stands beside the Blue Mosque as the defining monument of Istanbul.
mar-2.introZh: 圣索菲亚由查士丁尼皇帝于公元532至537年建造，在近千年间一直是世界上最大的教堂。巨大的中央穹顶、高悬的马赛克天使与流光溢彩的石材改变了建筑史。它先后作为教堂、清真寺、博物馆使用，2020年再次恢复为清真寺，与蓝色清真寺并列为伊斯坦布尔最具代表性的地标。

mar-3.location: Sultanahmet, İstanbul, Türkiye · 土耳其伊斯坦布尔苏丹艾哈迈德
mar-3.intro: The Blue Mosque was commissioned by Sultan Ahmed I and completed in 1617, facing Hagia Sophia across the Hippodrome. Its six minarets and cascade of domes are matched inside by more than twenty thousand hand-painted İznik tiles, whose blue tones give the mosque its popular name. It remains an active place of worship and one of the city's most visited monuments.
mar-3.introZh: 蓝色清真寺由苏丹艾哈迈德一世下令修建，1617年落成，与圣索菲亚隔古竞技场相望。六座宣礼塔与层叠穹顶极为醒目，内部镶嵌两万余块手工绘制的伊兹尼克瓷砖，蓝色调使其得名“蓝色清真寺”。它至今仍是活跃的礼拜场所，也是伊斯坦布尔游客最多的古迹之一。

mar-4.location: Sarayburnu, İstanbul, Türkiye · 土耳其伊斯坦布尔萨拉伊布尔努
mar-4.intro: Topkapı Palace was the residence of Ottoman sultans and the centre of imperial government from the 1460s until the 1850s. Its courtyards, harem, treasury and pavilions overlook the Bosphorus and the Golden Horn. The palace displays the imperial crown jewels, Ottoman robes, weapons and religious relics, and its tiled Baghdad and Circumcision pavilions are masterpieces of Ottoman architecture.
mar-4.introZh: 托普卡帕宫自15世纪60年代至19世纪50年代一直是奥斯曼苏丹的居所与帝国政务中心。宫殿的庭院、后宫、宝库和亭阁俯瞰博斯普鲁斯海峡与金角湾，收藏着帝国珠宝、奥斯曼服饰、兵器与宗教圣物。巴格达亭与割礼亭的瓷砖装饰是奥斯曼建筑的杰作。

mar-5.location: Beyazıt, İstanbul, Türkiye · 土耳其伊斯坦布尔贝亚泽特
mar-5.intro: The Grand Bazaar is one of the world's oldest and largest covered markets, founded after the Ottoman conquest of Constantinople and expanded over centuries. Its labyrinth of more than sixty streets and some four thousand shops sells carpets, ceramics, jewellery, leather and spices. The bazaar remains a working commercial quarter as much as a tourist attraction.
mar-5.introZh: 大巴扎是世界上历史最悠久、规模最大的室内市场之一，始建于奥斯曼征服君士坦丁堡之后，历经数百年扩建。六十多条街巷与约四千家店铺纵横交错，出售地毯、陶瓷、珠宝、皮革与香料。它不仅是旅游景点，也是仍在运转的庞大商业街区。

mar-6.location: Sultanahmet, İstanbul, Türkiye · 土耳其伊斯坦布尔苏丹艾哈迈德
mar-6.intro: The Basilica Cistern was built in the sixth century under Justinian to store water for the Great Palace. Its vast underground hall is carried by 336 marble columns, many reused from earlier Roman structures, and its dim, watery atmosphere is famous for the two Medusa-head column bases. Wooden walkways now let visitors explore the cistern.
mar-6.introZh: 地下水宫建于公元6世纪查士丁尼时期，为大皇宫蓄水而建。巨大的地下厅堂由336根大理石柱支撑，许多柱子取自更早的罗马建筑；幽暗的水面与两根美杜莎头像柱础营造出神秘氛围。如今铺设了木栈道，游客可深入参观。

mar-7.location: Süleymaniye, İstanbul, Türkiye · 土耳其伊斯坦布尔苏莱曼尼耶
mar-7.intro: The Süleymaniye Mosque was built for Sultan Süleyman the Magnificent between 1550 and 1557 to a design by the architect Sinan, his acknowledged masterpiece. The mosque crowns the Third Hill above the Golden Horn, with a dome higher than that of Hagia Sophia and a great complex of madrasas, hospital, baths and tombs. Its courtyard offers one of the finest views of the historic peninsula.
mar-7.introZh: 苏莱曼尼耶清真寺由苏丹苏莱曼大帝下令修建，1550至1557年由建筑师锡南设计，被视为其毕生杰作。清真寺雄踞金角湾上方的第三山丘，穹顶高度超过圣索菲亚，周围环绕着神学院、医院、浴室与陵墓组成的庞大建筑群。庭院是眺望历史半岛的最佳位置之一。

mar-8.location: Beyoğlu, İstanbul, Türkiye · 土耳其伊斯坦布尔贝伊奥卢
mar-8.intro: Galata Tower was built by the Genoese in 1348 as part of their fortified colony on the north shore of the Golden Horn. Its conical roof and stone cylinder dominate the skyline, and the gallery gives a panoramic view of the historic peninsula. Below it, Beyoğlu's İstiklal Avenue is Istanbul's great promenade of cafés, bookshops, churches and nightlife.
mar-8.introZh: 加拉塔塔由热那亚人于1348年建造，是其金角湾北岸殖民地的防御工事之一。圆锥形塔顶与石砌塔身主导着城市天际线，观景台可俯瞰历史半岛全景。塔下的贝伊奥卢区以独立大街为核心，是伊斯坦布尔著名的咖啡馆、书店、教堂与夜生活长廊。

mar-9.location: Beşiktaş, İstanbul, Türkiye · 土耳其伊斯坦布尔贝西克塔什
mar-9.intro: Dolmabahçe Palace was built between 1843 and 1856 as the modern, European-style residence of the Ottoman sultans on the Bosphorus. Its ceremonial halls are famous for a 4.5-tonne crystal chandelier and a staircase of Baccarat crystal, while the palace also holds the room where Mustafa Kemal Atatürk died in 1938. The waterfront gardens and gates are among the most photographed in Istanbul.
mar-9.introZh: 多尔玛巴赫切宫建于1843至1856年，是奥斯曼苏丹在博斯普鲁斯海峡畔的欧式新宫。礼仪大厅以4.5吨重的水晶吊灯和巴卡拉水晶楼梯闻名，1938年穆斯塔法·凯末尔·阿塔图尔克也在此逝世。临水花园与宫门是伊斯坦布尔最常被拍摄的景观之一。

mar-10.location: İstanbul, Türkiye · 土耳其伊斯坦布尔
mar-10.intro: A Bosphorus cruise follows the strait that divides Europe and Asia, passing Ottoman palaces, wooden yalı houses, fortresses and fishing villages. Regular ferries run from Eminönü and Beşiktaş toward the Black Sea, while shorter tours concentrate on the castles and mansions of the middle strait. The journey offers the classic panorama of Istanbul from the water.
mar-10.introZh: 博斯普鲁斯海峡游船沿分隔欧亚两洲的海峡航行，途经奥斯曼宫殿、木造滨海别墅、城堡与渔村。定期渡轮从艾米诺努和贝西克塔什驶向黑海，短线游船则集中游览海峡中段的城堡与宅邸。从水面眺望，是欣赏伊斯坦布尔全景的经典方式。

mar-11.location: Fatih, İstanbul, Türkiye · 土耳其伊斯坦布尔法提赫
mar-11.intro: Balat and Fener are neighbouring quarters on the Golden Horn whose Greek, Jewish and Armenian communities shaped Istanbul for centuries. Their steep streets are lined with brightly painted Ottoman houses, historic synagogues, Orthodox churches and the imposing Fener Greek Patriarchate. Cafés, antique shops and street art have made the area a favourite for slow walks and photography.
mar-11.introZh: 巴拉特与费内尔是金角湾畔相邻的两个街区，希腊、犹太与亚美尼亚社群曾在此生活数百年，深刻塑造了伊斯坦布尔。陡峭街巷两侧是色彩鲜艳的奥斯曼老屋、历史悠久的犹太会堂、东正教堂以及庄严的费内尔希腊牧首座堂。咖啡馆、古董店与街头艺术使这里成为漫步与摄影的热门去处。

mar-12.location: Kadıköy, İstanbul, Türkiye · 土耳其伊斯坦布尔卡德柯伊
mar-12.intro: Kadıköy is the lively heart of Istanbul's Asian side, centred on a historic produce market and a web of streets filled with meyhanes, coffee roasters and bookshops. The adjoining Moda quarter follows a leafy seafront promenade with views back across the Marmara Sea to the old city. It is the best place to experience everyday Istanbul away from the monument circuit.
mar-12.introZh: 卡德柯伊是伊斯坦布尔亚洲岸最热闹的中心，以历史悠久的菜市场为核心，街巷间遍布小酒馆、咖啡烘焙店与书店。相邻的莫达区沿绿树成荫的海滨大道延伸，可隔马尔马拉海回望老城。若要体验古迹路线之外的市民日常，这里是理想去处。

mar-13.location: Adalar, İstanbul, Türkiye · 土耳其伊斯坦布尔阿达拉尔
mar-13.intro: The Princes' Islands are a car-free archipelago in the Sea of Marmara, reached by ferry from the city. Büyükada, the largest, is known for its pine woods, Victorian wooden mansions, horse-drawn carriages and cycling routes, with monasteries and hilltop viewpoints. The islands offer a quiet, nostalgic escape from the density of central Istanbul.
mar-13.introZh: 王子群岛是马尔马拉海中的无车群岛，从市区乘渡轮即可抵达。最大的比于克阿达岛以松林、维多利亚式木造宅邸、马车与自行车道闻名，还有修道院和山顶观景点。这里为密集的伊斯坦布尔市中心提供了一处安静而怀旧的逃离之地。

mar-14.location: Edirnekapı, İstanbul, Türkiye · 土耳其伊斯坦布尔埃迪尔内卡普
mar-14.intro: The Chora Church preserves the finest surviving cycle of Byzantine mosaics and frescoes in Istanbul, created in the early fourteenth century. Its scenes of the life of Christ and the Virgin, set in shimmering gold, are masterpieces of late Byzantine art. The building was converted into a mosque in 2020 and its museum function ended, so access can be restricted during restoration.
mar-14.introZh: 柯拉教堂保存着伊斯坦布尔最精美的拜占庭马赛克与湿壁画组，创作于14世纪初。以金色为底的基督与圣母生平场景是晚期拜占庭艺术的杰作。该建筑于2020年改为清真寺，博物馆功能终止，修复期间开放可能受限。

mar-15.location: Tevfikiye, Çanakkale, Türkiye · 土耳其恰纳卡莱特夫菲基耶
mar-15.intro: Troy is a tell with nine superimposed cities, occupied from about 3000 BC to the Roman period, and the traditional setting of Homer's Iliad. Excavations have revealed the walls, gates and houses of the Bronze Age citadel, a Roman theatre and the great defensive ditch. A replica Trojan Horse near the entrance and the nearby museum complete the visit.
mar-15.introZh: 特洛伊遗址由九层叠压的古城组成，从约公元前3000年延续至罗马时代，也是荷马《伊利亚特》故事的传统发生地。考古发掘揭示了青铜时代卫城的城墙、城门与住宅，以及罗马剧场和大型防御壕沟。入口处的特洛伊木马复制品与附近博物馆使参观更为完整。

mar-16.location: Çanakkale, Türkiye · 土耳其恰纳卡莱
mar-16.intro: The Gallipoli Peninsula is the site of the 1915 campaign in which Allied forces tried to force the Dardanelles and were held by Ottoman defenders. Cemeteries, memorials and trenches commemorate soldiers from Turkey, Australia, New Zealand, Britain, France and other nations. The peninsula is also a national park of pine woods, cliffs and quiet beaches.
mar-16.introZh: 加里波利半岛是1915年战役的发生地，协约国军队试图强渡达达尼尔海峡，被奥斯曼守军击退。这里的墓地、纪念碑与战壕纪念着土耳其、澳大利亚、新西兰、英国、法国等国士兵。半岛同时是遍布松林、悬崖与宁静海滩的国家公园。

mar-17.location: Behramkale, Çanakkale, Türkiye · 土耳其恰纳卡莱贝赫拉姆卡莱
mar-17.intro: Assos is an ancient Aegean city built on a volcanic headland, crowned by a sixth-century BC temple of Athena whose columns frame the sea. Aristotle lived and taught here for several years, and the harbour below is lined with stone houses and fish restaurants. The site is celebrated for its sunset views over the Greek island of Lesbos.
mar-17.introZh: 阿索斯是建在火山岬角上的古希腊爱琴海城市，卫城上的雅典娜神庙建于公元前6世纪，石柱间可眺望大海。亚里士多德曾在此居住讲学数年，山下的港口布满石屋与海鲜餐馆。这里以俯瞰希腊莱斯博斯岛的日落景色著称。

mar-18.location: Bozcaada, Çanakkale, Türkiye · 土耳其恰纳卡莱博兹贾阿达
mar-18.intro: Bozcaada is a small Aegean island of vineyards, windmills, quiet coves and a well-preserved Genoese castle. Its compact Greek-Turkish town has cobbled lanes, churches, a mosque and excellent seafood, while the island's wineries produce some of Türkiye's best-known wines. Ferries connect it to the mainland near Çanakkale.
mar-18.introZh: 博兹贾阿达是爱琴海上的小岛，以葡萄园、风车、宁静海湾和保存完好的热那亚城堡闻名。紧凑的希土混居小镇有石板街、教堂、清真寺与出色的海鲜，岛上酒庄出产土耳其最知名的葡萄酒之一。渡轮将其与恰纳卡莱附近的大陆相连。

mar-19.location: Edirne, Türkiye · 土耳其埃迪尔内
mar-19.intro: The Selimiye Mosque was built by the architect Sinan for Sultan Selim II between 1569 and 1575 and is widely considered his finest work. Its single great dome, carried on eight massive piers, spans a space larger than that of Hagia Sophia, while the four slender minarets rise to 71 metres. The mosque, madrasas and bazaar form a complete Ottoman külliye inscribed by UNESCO in 2011.
mar-19.introZh: 塞利米耶清真寺由建筑师锡南为苏丹塞利姆二世建造，1569至1575年完工，被公认为其巅峰之作。单一巨大穹顶由八根巨型墩柱支撑，覆盖空间超过圣索菲亚，四座细长宣礼塔高达71米。清真寺、神学院与巴扎组成完整的奥斯曼建筑群，2011年列入世界遗产。

mar-20.location: Edirne, Türkiye · 土耳其埃迪尔内
mar-20.intro: Edirne was the Ottoman capital before Istanbul and preserves a rich ensemble of imperial monuments, including the Üç Şerefeli Mosque with its famous three-balcony minaret, the Beyazıt II complex and the Ali Pasha Bazaar. The old town spreads around these buildings and the river bridges of the Tunca and Meriç, with a relaxed, Balkan atmosphere.
mar-20.introZh: 埃迪尔内在伊斯坦布尔之前曾是奥斯曼帝国首都，保存着丰富的帝国古迹，包括以三阳台宣礼塔闻名的于奇谢雷费利清真寺、巴耶济德二世建筑群和阿里帕夏巴扎。老城围绕这些建筑与通贾河、马里查河上的桥梁展开，带有悠闲的巴尔干气息。

mar-21.location: İznik, Bursa, Türkiye · 土耳其布尔萨伊兹尼克
mar-21.intro: İznik is ancient Nicaea, famous as the site of the first and second ecumenical councils and for its well-preserved Byzantine walls and gates. The town's Ottoman monuments include the Green Mosque and the Nilüfer Hatun soup kitchen, while its tile workshops revived the celebrated blue-and-turquoise ceramics that decorate mosques across Türkiye.
mar-21.introZh: 伊兹尼克即古代尼西亚，以第一次和第二次大公会议召开地闻名，保存着完好的拜占庭城墙与城门。奥斯曼时期的绿色清真寺与尼吕费尔哈通济贫院也值得一看；当地瓷砖工坊复兴了著名的蓝绿釉陶瓷，土耳其各地清真寺的装饰常出自于此。

mar-22.location: Bursa, Türkiye · 土耳其布尔萨
mar-22.intro: Bursa was the first capital of the Ottoman Empire, and its historic core around Ulu Cami, the Green Mosque and the Yeşil Türbe contains the earliest masterpieces of Ottoman architecture. The UNESCO property, inscribed in 2014 together with Cumalıkızık, also includes hans, baths, madrasas and the tombs of the first sultans.
mar-22.introZh: 布尔萨是奥斯曼帝国的第一座首都，以大清真寺、绿色清真寺和绿色陵墓为核心的历史城区保存着奥斯曼建筑最早期的杰作。该世界遗产于2014年与朱马勒克兹克村一同列入，还包括客栈、浴室、神学院及早期苏丹陵墓。

mar-23.location: Bursa, Türkiye · 土耳其布尔萨
mar-23.intro: Cumalıkızık is a preserved Ottoman village at the foot of Uludağ, founded in the early Ottoman period and still inhabited. Its narrow cobbled lanes, half-timbered houses with whitewashed walls and stone courtyards, and small mosque give an unusually complete picture of rural Ottoman life. The village forms part of the Bursa and Cumalıkızık World Heritage property.
mar-23.introZh: 朱马勒克兹克是乌卢达山脚保存完好的奥斯曼村庄，始建于奥斯曼早期，至今仍有人居住。狭窄的石板路、白墙木构架房屋、石砌庭院与小清真寺，完整呈现了奥斯曼乡村生活面貌。该村与布尔萨历史核心区共同构成世界遗产。

mar-24.location: Bursa, Türkiye · 土耳其布尔萨
mar-24.intro: The Ulu Cami of Bursa was completed in 1399 and is one of the great early Ottoman mosques, famous for its twenty domes, central fountain and monumental calligraphy. Beside it, the Koza Han is a two-storey silk caravanserai built in 1491, still trading in silk scarves and textiles. Together they anchor Bursa's historic bazaar district.
mar-24.introZh: 布尔萨大清真寺完成于1399年，是奥斯曼早期重要清真寺之一，以二十个穹顶、中央水池和巨幅书法装饰闻名。旁边的科扎汗是1491年建成的两层丝绸商队客栈，至今仍经营丝巾与纺织品。两者共同构成布尔萨历史巴扎区的核心。

mar-25.location: Bursa, Türkiye · 土耳其布尔萨
mar-25.intro: Uludağ rises to 2,543 metres above Bursa and is the most accessible winter sports centre in western Türkiye. In summer its national park offers hiking, alpine meadows and views over the Marmara Sea, while a cable car connects the city to the slopes. The mountain was known in antiquity as Mysian Olympus.
mar-25.introZh: 乌卢达山海拔2543米，是土耳其西部最易到达的冬季运动中心。夏季的国家公园适合徒步，可欣赏高山草甸与马尔马拉海景色，缆车将市区与山坡相连。此山在古代被称为密西亚奥林匹斯山。

aeg-26.location: Pamukkale, Denizli, Türkiye · 土耳其代尼兹利棉花堡
aeg-26.intro: Pamukkale means "cotton castle", a dazzling hillside of white travertine terraces formed by calcium-rich hot springs. Above the terraces stand the ruins of Hierapolis, a Greco-Roman spa city with a huge theatre, Apollo temple, colonnaded streets and the Plutonium, a sacred cave linked to the underworld. The combined cultural and natural property has been UNESCO-listed since 1988.
aeg-26.introZh: “棉花堡”意为“棉花城堡”，是富含钙质的温泉在山上沉积出的白色石灰华阶地，层层叠叠、耀眼夺目。阶地上方是希拉波利斯古城遗址，这座希腊—罗马温泉城拥有巨大剧场、阿波罗神庙、列柱大道，以及与冥界相连的圣洞“普鲁托尼翁”。该文化与自然双重遗产于1988年列入世界遗产。

aeg-27.location: Selçuk, İzmir, Türkiye · 土耳其伊兹密尔塞尔丘克
aeg-27.intro: Ephesus was one of the greatest cities of the Roman world and the capital of Asia Minor, with a harbour that has since silted up. Its marble streets lead past the Library of Celsus, the Great Theatre for 25,000 spectators, the Terrace Houses, the Temple of Hadrian and the Arcadian Way. The site also holds early Christian associations, including St Paul's ministry and the nearby House of the Virgin Mary.
aeg-27.introZh: 以弗所是罗马世界最伟大的城市之一、小亚细亚首府，其古港后来淤积成陆。大理石街道串联起塞尔苏斯图书馆、可容纳2.5万人的大剧场、露台住宅、哈德良神庙与阿卡迪亚大道。这里也与早期基督教密切相关，包括圣保罗的传教活动以及附近的圣母玛利亚故居。

aeg-28.location: Bergama, İzmir, Türkiye · 土耳其伊兹密尔贝尔加马
aeg-28.intro: Pergamon was the capital of the Attalid kingdom and a great centre of Hellenistic art and learning, famous for its library and the Altar of Zeus. Its acropolis climbs a steep hill above the plain, with the world's steepest ancient theatre, a vast trajan temple and an arsenal of royal palaces. Below lie the Asklepion healing sanctuary and the Red Basilica, a monumental Roman temple later converted into a church.
aeg-28.introZh: 佩加蒙是阿塔罗斯王国的首都，也是希腊化艺术与学术重镇，以图书馆和宙斯祭坛闻名。卫城依陡峭山势而上，拥有世界上最陡的古代剧场、宏大的图拉真神庙与王室宫殿群。山下是阿斯克勒庇俄斯疗养圣所与红色大教堂——一座后来改为教堂的罗马神庙。

aeg-29.location: Karacasu, Aydın, Türkiye · 土耳其艾登卡拉贾苏
aeg-29.intro: Aphrodisias was a prosperous Roman city dedicated to Aphrodite, built beside a marble quarry that supplied its superb sculptors. Its monuments include a huge temple of Aphrodite, a 30,000-seat stadium, a theatre, baths and a monumental gateway, while the site museum displays one of the finest collections of Roman sculpture in Anatolia. UNESCO inscribed the city and its marble quarries in 2017.
aeg-29.introZh: 阿弗罗狄西亚是一座繁荣的罗马城市，供奉爱与美之神阿弗罗狄忒，毗邻大理石采石场，孕育了技艺高超的雕刻师。城中有宏伟的阿弗罗狄忒神庙、可容三万人的体育场、剧场、浴场与纪念性城门，博物馆则收藏着安纳托利亚最精美的罗马雕塑之一。2017年，古城与采石场一同列入世界遗产。

aeg-30.location: Salihli, Manisa, Türkiye · 土耳其马尼萨萨利赫利
aeg-30.intro: Sardis was the capital of the Lydian kingdom, whose king Croesus became a byword for wealth, and later a major Roman city. Excavations have uncovered the monumental Temple of Artemis, a huge Roman bath-gymnasium complex, a synagogue and the gold-refining workshops of the Lydians. Nearby Bin Tepe holds the enormous burial mounds of Lydian kings, including the tumulus of Alyattes. The property was inscribed in 2025.
aeg-30.introZh: 萨第斯是吕底亚王国的首都，国王克罗伊斯以巨富闻名，后来发展为重要的罗马城市。考古发现了宏伟的阿耳忒弥斯神庙、大型罗马浴场—体育场建筑群、犹太会堂以及吕底亚人的炼金作坊。附近的宾特佩散布着吕底亚王陵巨冢，包括阿利亚特斯土丘。该遗产于2025年列入世界遗产。

aeg-31.location: Selçuk, İzmir, Türkiye · 土耳其伊兹密尔塞尔丘克
aeg-31.intro: The Basilica of St John was built by Emperor Justinian in the sixth century over the traditional tomb of John the Evangelist, on the hill of Ayasoluk above Ephesus. Its cruciform plan and massive brick piers still convey its former scale. Below stands the İsa Bey Mosque, completed in 1375, one of the finest examples of Anatolian Seljuk architecture with a richly carved portal.
aeg-31.introZh: 圣约翰大教堂由查士丁尼皇帝于6世纪建于以弗所上方的阿亚索卢克山，相传圣约翰福音书作者葬于此。其十字形平面与巨大砖墩仍可看出昔日规模。教堂下方的伊萨贝伊清真寺完成于1375年，是安纳托利亚塞尔柱建筑的代表作之一，正门雕刻尤为精美。

aeg-32.location: Selçuk, İzmir, Türkiye · 土耳其伊兹密尔塞尔丘克
aeg-32.intro: Şirince is a hillside village of whitewashed houses and red-tiled roofs above the valley of Selçuk, once a Greek settlement and now known for its fruit wines, olive oil and handicrafts. Its steep lanes, old churches and view over the surrounding hills make it a popular escape from the crowds at Ephesus, especially in spring and autumn.
aeg-32.introZh: 希林杰是塞尔丘克山谷上方的小山村，白墙红瓦的房屋沿山坡而建，曾是希腊人聚落，如今以果酒、橄榄油与手工艺闻名。陡峭的街巷、古老教堂与周围丘陵景色，使其成为逃离以弗所人潮的热门去处，春秋两季尤其宜人。

aeg-33.location: İzmir, Türkiye · 土耳其伊兹密尔
aeg-33.intro: The Kordon is İzmir's seafront promenade, a long line of palm trees, lawns, cafés and bicycle paths facing the Aegean. At its southern end stands Konak Square with the slender Ottoman clock tower, the symbol of the city, and the nearby Kemeraltı bazaar. The waterfront comes alive at sunset, when locals gather for tea, street food and the ferry across the bay.
aeg-33.introZh: 科尔东是伊兹密尔的滨海长廊，棕榈树、草坪、咖啡馆与自行车道沿爱琴海岸延伸。南端的科纳克广场矗立着细长的奥斯曼钟楼，是城市的象征，附近即凯梅拉尔特巴扎。日落时分，当地人聚集于此喝茶、吃街头小吃、乘渡轮横渡海湾，滨海大道格外热闹。

aeg-34.location: İzmir, Türkiye · 土耳其伊兹密尔
aeg-34.intro: Kemeraltı is one of the largest and liveliest historic bazaars in Türkiye, a dense quarter of covered streets, hans, mosques, synagogues and churches near Konak. It has traded since the seventeenth century and remains the place to buy spices, dried fruit, coffee, textiles and local specialties. The bazaar's layered religious architecture reflects İzmir's cosmopolitan past.
aeg-34.introZh: 凯梅拉尔特是土耳其规模最大、最有活力的历史巴扎之一，科纳克附近密集的拱顶街巷、客栈、清真寺、犹太会堂与教堂交织成网。这里自17世纪起经商至今，仍是购买香料、干果、咖啡、纺织品与地方特产的好去处。多元宗教建筑见证了伊兹密尔昔日的国际都市面貌。

aeg-35.intro: Kuşadası is a cruise and beach resort on the Aegean coast, backed by the pine-covered Dilek Peninsula and facing the Greek island of Samos. Its harbour, marina and long promenade serve as the main gateway to Ephesus, while nearby beaches, national park trails and boat trips make it a base for several days.
aeg-35.introZh: 库萨达斯是爱琴海岸的邮轮与海滨度假城市，背靠松林覆盖的迪莱克半岛，与希腊萨摩斯岛隔海相望。港口、游艇码头与长长的海滨步道使其成为前往以弗所的主要门户；附近的海滩、国家公园步道与游船也让这里适合多日停留。

aeg-36.intro: This trio of Ionian sites lies south of Kuşadası. Priene is a beautifully planned Hellenistic city on a hillside, with a temple of Athena and a theatre; Miletus was a great trading city with a vast Roman theatre and baths; Didyma held the oracle of Apollo and the enormous Temple of Apollo, whose columns still stand. Together they trace the intellectual and commercial life of ancient Ionia.
aeg-36.introZh: 这三处爱奥尼亚遗址位于库萨达斯以南。普里埃内是依山而建、规划严整的希腊化城市，有雅典娜神庙与剧场；米利都是重要贸易城邦，拥有宏大的罗马剧场与浴场；迪迪马曾是阿波罗神谕所，巨大的阿波罗神庙石柱至今仍矗立。三地共同勾勒出古代爱奥尼亚的思想与商业生活。

aeg-37.location: Bodrum, Muğla, Türkiye · 土耳其穆拉博德鲁姆
aeg-37.intro: Bodrum Castle was built by the Knights of St John in the fifteenth century using stone from the Mausoleum of Halicarnassus, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. The castle now houses the Museum of Underwater Archaeology, with shipwrecks and artefacts from the Aegean. Only foundations and a few sculptures remain of the Mausoleum itself, once the tomb of King Mausolus.
aeg-37.introZh: 博德鲁姆城堡由圣约翰骑士团于15世纪建造，石料取自古代世界七大奇迹之一的摩索拉斯陵墓。城堡现为水下考古博物馆，陈列爱琴海沉船与出水文物。陵墓本身仅存基座与少量雕塑，这里曾是摩索拉斯国王的陵寝，“陵墓”一词即源于其名。

aeg-38.location: Bodrum, Muğla, Türkiye · 土耳其穆拉博德鲁姆
aeg-38.intro: The Bodrum peninsula is lined with coves, beach clubs and small resorts such as Türkbükü, Gümüşlük and Bitez. Its whitewashed houses, bougainvillea and blue waters have made it a summer favourite for Turkish and international visitors. After dark, Bodrum's bars and clubs along the marina are among the liveliest on the Aegean coast.
aeg-38.introZh: 博德鲁姆半岛遍布海湾、海滩俱乐部与小度假村，如蒂尔克布库、居米什吕克和比泰兹。白墙房屋、三角梅与湛蓝海水使其成为土耳其及国际游客的夏季热门目的地。入夜后，码头沿线的酒吧与夜店是爱琴海岸最热闹的场所之一。

aeg-39.location: İzmir, Türkiye · 土耳其伊兹密尔
aeg-39.intro: Çeşme is a resort town at the western tip of Anatolia, known for its castle, thermal springs and clear beaches, while nearby Alaçatı is a stone-house village of bougainvillea lanes, boutique hotels and windsurfing beaches. The area has become one of the Aegean's most fashionable summer destinations, with a strong food and wine scene.
aeg-39.introZh: 切什梅位于安纳托利亚西端，以城堡、温泉与清澈海滩闻名；附近的阿拉恰特则是石屋村落，三角梅小巷、精品酒店与风帆海滩别具风情。这一带已成为爱琴海最时尚的夏季度假地之一，餐饮与葡萄酒氛围浓厚。

aeg-40.location: İzmir, Türkiye · 土耳其伊兹密尔
aeg-40.intro: Foça is an old Aegean port built on the site of ancient Phocaea, with a Genoese castle, a small bazaar and a harbour lined with fish restaurants. Boat trips visit the nearby islands and coves, and the town retains a quiet, local character compared with the larger resorts. It is also a centre for diving and sailing.
aeg-40.introZh: 福恰是建于古代福西亚遗址上的爱琴海老港，拥有热那亚城堡、小巴扎与遍布海鲜餐馆的港湾。游船可前往附近岛屿与海湾，与大型度假地相比，小镇保留了安静而本地化的气质。这里也是潜水与帆船运动中心。

aeg-41.location: Balıkesir, Türkiye · 土耳其巴勒克埃西尔
aeg-41.intro: Ayvalık is a former Greek town of neoclassical houses and olive-oil presses on the Aegean coast, facing the island of Lesbos. Across a causeway, Cunda (Alibey Island) has stone churches, a windmill, seafood tavernas and a relaxed island atmosphere. The surrounding archipelago is popular for boat trips and diving.
aeg-41.introZh: 艾瓦勒克是爱琴海岸的前希腊人城镇，新古典主义宅邸与橄榄油作坊林立，与希腊莱斯博斯岛隔海相望。经堤道相连的俊达岛（阿里贝伊岛）有石砌教堂、风车、海鲜小馆与悠闲的岛屿氛围。周边群岛适合游船与潜水。

aeg-42.location: Afyonkarahisar, Türkiye · 土耳其阿菲永卡拉希萨尔
aeg-42.intro: The Ulu Cami of Afyonkarahisar is one of the five wooden hypostyle mosques inscribed by UNESCO in 2023. Its flat timber ceiling is carried by rows of carved wooden columns, a building tradition of medieval Anatolia that blends Seljuk and later Ottoman techniques. The mosque stands below the dramatic rock castle that gives the city its name.
aeg-42.introZh: 阿菲永卡拉希萨尔大清真寺是2023年列入世界遗产的五座木柱清真寺之一。平直的木制天花由一排排雕花木柱支撑，体现了安纳托利亚中世纪融合塞尔柱与奥斯曼传统的建筑技艺。清真寺位于赋予城市名称的险峻岩石城堡下方。

aeg-43.location: Ağlasun, Burdur, Türkiye · 土耳其布尔杜尔阿格拉松
aeg-43.intro: Sagalassos is a Roman city perched at about 1,500 metres in the Taurus Mountains, with a theatre, council house, baths, library and a reconstructed fountain house. Its high setting, snow-capped views and ongoing excavations make it one of the most atmospheric archaeological sites in the Turkish Mediterranean. The city flourished in the second century AD.
aeg-43.introZh: 萨加拉索斯是托罗斯山脉中海拔约1500米的罗马城市，拥有剧场、议事厅、浴场、图书馆与修复后的喷泉建筑。高海拔环境、雪山景色与持续的考古发掘，使其成为土耳其地中海地区最具氛围的遗址之一。城市在公元2世纪达到繁荣。

med-44.location: Kınık, Antalya, Türkiye · 土耳其安塔利亚克讷克
med-44.intro: Xanthos was the capital of ancient Lycia, set on a hill above the Xanthos river near the coast. Its Roman theatre, agora and pillar tombs — including the famous Harpy Tomb and the Nereid Monument, now in the British Museum — reflect a distinctive Lycian culture that blended Anatolian, Greek and Persian influences. The city was inscribed with Letoon in 1988.
med-44.introZh: 克桑托斯是古代吕基亚王国的首都，坐落于海岸附近克桑托斯河上的山丘。罗马剧场、市场与柱式陵墓——包括著名的哈耳庇厄墓和现藏大英博物馆的女神涅瑞伊得斯纪念碑——展现了融合安纳托利亚、希腊与波斯影响的独特吕基亚文化。1988年与莱顿共同列入世界遗产。

med-45.location: Kumluova, Muğla, Türkiye · 土耳其穆拉库姆卢奥瓦
med-45.intro: Letoon was the federal sanctuary of Lycia, dedicated to Leto and her children Artemis and Apollo, and the religious centre of the Lycian League. Three temples stand beside a sacred spring, and inscriptions found here were crucial to deciphering the Lycian language. It is the companion World Heritage site to Xanthos.
med-45.introZh: 莱顿是吕基亚联盟的联邦圣所，供奉勒托及其子女阿耳忒弥斯与阿波罗，也是吕基亚人的宗教中心。三座神庙围绕圣泉而立，此处发现的铭文对解读吕基亚文字至关重要。它与克桑托斯共同构成一处世界遗产。

med-46.location: Antalya, Türkiye · 土耳其安塔利亚
med-46.intro: Kaleiçi is the old quarter of Antalya, wrapped around a Roman-era harbour and enclosed by Byzantine and Seljuk walls. Its narrow lanes are lined with Ottoman houses, boutique hotels, mosques and the Hadrian's Gate, built for the emperor's visit in AD 130. The cliff-top park and marina make it one of the most pleasant historic centres on the Turkish coast.
med-46.introZh: 卡莱伊奇是安塔利亚老城，围绕罗马时代港口展开，被拜占庭与塞尔柱城墙环抱。狭窄街巷两侧是奥斯曼老屋、精品旅馆、清真寺，以及为纪念哈德良皇帝公元130年到访而建的哈德良门。崖顶公园与游艇码头使其成为土耳其海岸最宜人的历史中心之一。

med-47.location: Antalya, Türkiye · 土耳其安塔利亚
med-47.intro: The Antalya Museum holds one of Türkiye's outstanding archaeological collections, especially Roman sculpture from Perge and the surrounding region. Its galleries cover prehistory, Lycia, the classical world, Byzantine icons and Ottoman life, and the Hall of the Gods displays statues of mythological figures. It is an essential complement to visits to the ancient cities along the coast.
med-47.introZh: 安塔利亚博物馆收藏着土耳其最重要的考古藏品之一，尤其是来自佩尔盖及周边地区的罗马雕塑。展厅涵盖史前、吕基亚、古典世界、拜占庭圣像与奥斯曼生活，“众神厅”陈列神话人物雕像。参观海岸沿线古城后，这里是不容错过的一站。

med-48.location: Antalya, Türkiye · 土耳其安塔利亚
med-48.intro: The Düden river forms two waterfalls near Antalya: the Upper Düden, a wooded park where the water drops into a canyon, and the Lower Düden, which plunges directly into the Mediterranean from the city's cliffs. Boat trips approach the coastal cascade from the sea, and the surrounding parks are popular picnic spots.
med-48.introZh: 杜登河在安塔利亚附近形成两处瀑布：上杜登瀑布位于林木茂密的公园，水流坠入峡谷；下杜登瀑布则从城市悬崖直落地中海。游船可从海上靠近这处海岸瀑布，周边公园也是热门野餐地。

med-49.location: Aksu, Antalya, Türkiye · 土耳其安塔利亚阿克苏
med-49.intro: Perge was a wealthy Pamphylian city, reached by a colonnaded street that leads past a theatre, stadium, baths and the monumental Hellenistic gateways. Its sculpture school produced works now displayed in the Antalya Museum, and the site is closely associated with St Paul's travels. The extensive ruins make it one of the most rewarding ancient cities near Antalya.
med-49.introZh: 佩尔盖是富庶的潘菲利亚城市，列柱大道穿过剧场、体育场、浴场与宏伟的希腊化城门。其雕刻流派的作品如今陈列于安塔利亚博物馆，这里也与圣保罗的旅程密切相关。规模宏大的遗址使其成为安塔利亚附近最值得探访的古城之一。

med-50.location: Serik, Antalya, Türkiye · 土耳其安塔利亚塞里克
med-50.intro: Aspendos is famous for its Roman theatre, built in the second century AD and still remarkably intact, with a 15,000-seat cavea and a decorated stage building. The theatre's acoustics are so good that it continues to host opera and ballet festivals. The nearby city ruins include a stadium, aqueduct and basilica.
med-50.introZh: 阿斯潘多斯以罗马剧场闻名，剧场建于公元2世纪，至今保存极为完整，拥有1.5万个座位的观众席与装饰精美的舞台建筑。音响效果极佳，至今仍举办歌剧与芭蕾节。附近古城遗址还有体育场、引水渠与巴西利卡。

med-51.location: Manavgat, Antalya, Türkiye · 土耳其安塔利亚马纳夫加特
med-51.intro: Side is a former Pamphylian port whose peninsula is packed with Roman ruins, including a theatre, baths, city gates and the Temple of Apollo standing at the water's edge. The modern resort has grown around the ancient streets, and the beach beside the temples is one of the most photogenic on the Turkish Riviera.
med-51.introZh: 西代是古代潘菲利亚港口，半岛上密布罗马遗迹，包括剧场、浴场、城门以及立于海边的阿波罗神庙。现代度假区围绕古城街巷发展，神庙旁的海滩是土耳其里维埃拉最上镜的景点之一。

med-52.location: Alanya, Antalya, Türkiye · 土耳其安塔利亚阿拉尼亚
med-52.intro: Alanya Castle crowns a rocky peninsula above the Mediterranean, with Seljuk walls, a citadel, the Red Tower and a shipyard built in the thirteenth century. Below, Cleopatra Beach stretches along the base of the cliff, named for the legend that Mark Antony gave the coast to Cleopatra. The combination of fortress views and beach makes Alanya a classic riviera stop.
med-52.introZh: 阿拉尼亚城堡雄踞地中海上的岩石半岛，拥有塞尔柱城墙、内堡、红塔与13世纪造船厂。山崖下的克利奥帕特拉海滩据传因马克·安东尼将海岸赠予克利奥帕特拉而得名。城堡景观与海滩相结合，使阿拉尼亚成为里维埃拉的经典一站。

med-53.location: Kumluca, Antalya, Türkiye · 土耳其安塔利亚库姆卢贾
med-53.intro: Olympos is a Lycian city hidden in a wooded gorge beside a pebble beach, with ruined houses, a theatre and tombs overgrown by vines. A short climb inland leads to Yanartaş (Chimera), where natural gas seeps from the mountainside and burns day and night. The combination of ruins, sea and eternal flames is unique on the Lycian Way.
med-53.introZh: 奥林波斯是藏在林木峡谷中的吕基亚古城，毗邻卵石海滩，残破的住宅、剧场与陵墓被藤蔓覆盖。向内陆短途攀登可到亚纳尔塔什（“奇美拉”），山体渗出的天然气昼夜燃烧。遗迹、大海与永恒之火相结合，在吕基亚之路上独树一帜。

med-54.location: Kemer, Antalya, Türkiye · 土耳其安塔利亚凯梅尔
med-54.intro: Phaselis was a Lycian trading city with three harbours, built on a low peninsula where pine trees grow among Roman streets, baths and a theatre. Its sheltered bays and sandy beaches make it a favourite for swimming and picnics, and the ruins are unusually easy to combine with a day at the sea.
med-54.introZh: 法塞利斯是拥有三个港口的吕基亚贸易城市，建在低矮半岛上，松树生长于罗马街道、浴场与剧场之间。隐蔽的海湾与沙滩使其成为游泳野餐的热门地，古迹与海滨一日游的结合格外轻松。

med-55.location: Döşemealtı, Antalya, Türkiye · 土耳其安塔利亚德舍梅阿尔特
med-55.intro: Termessos is a Pisidian mountain city at about 1,000 metres, so inaccessible that Alexander the Great failed to take it. Its ruins — theatre, agora, gymnasium, tombs and city walls — lie among pine forests and dramatic cliffs in a national park. The climb and the views make it one of the most adventurous ancient sites in the region.
med-55.introZh: 特尔梅索斯是海拔约1000米的皮西迪亚山城，地势险要，连亚历山大大帝也未能攻克。剧场、市场、体育场、陵墓与城墙散布在松林与陡崖之间，现属国家公园。攀登过程与壮丽景色使其成为该地区最具探险感的古城遗址。

med-56.location: Manavgat, Antalya, Türkiye · 土耳其安塔利亚马纳夫加特
med-56.intro: Köprülü Canyon is a deep limestone gorge cut by the Köprüçay river, crossed by a Roman bridge and lined with pine forest. It is the main rafting centre of the Turkish Mediterranean, with guided trips through rapids, and the surrounding national park offers walking, picnics and trout restaurants.
med-56.introZh: 科普吕吕峡谷是科普吕恰伊河切割出的深邃石灰岩峡谷，罗马桥横跨其上，两岸松林密布。这里是土耳其地中海地区主要的漂流中心，有向导带领的激流之旅；周边国家公园适合徒步、野餐与品尝鳟鱼。

med-57.location: Antalya, Türkiye · 土耳其安塔利亚
med-57.intro: Kaş is a small Aegean-style town on the Lycian coast, with a horseshoe harbour, bougainvillea lanes and a Greek island visible offshore. It is a centre for diving, sea kayaking and boat trips, and the Lycian Way passes nearby. Unlike larger resorts, Kaş has kept a relaxed, bohemian character.
med-57.introZh: 卡什是吕基亚海岸上的爱琴海风格小镇，拥有马蹄形港湾、三角梅小巷，隔海可见希腊岛屿。这里是潜水、海上皮划艇与游船活动的中心，吕基亚之路也从附近经过。与大型度假地不同，卡什保留了悠闲而波希米亚的气质。

med-58.location: Demre, Antalya, Türkiye · 土耳其安塔利亚代姆雷
med-58.intro: Kekova is a sheltered bay where the ruins of a sunken Lycian city lie beneath clear water, visible from glass-bottomed boats. Above the bay stands Simena (Kaleköy), a tiny village with a crusader castle, Lycian sarcophagi and a hillside of stone houses. Swimming over the submerged walls is one of the coast's signature experiences.
med-58.introZh: 凯科瓦是受庇护的海湾，清澈水下淹没着吕基亚古城遗址，可乘玻璃底船观赏。海湾上方的西梅纳（卡莱柯伊）是座小村，有十字军城堡、吕基亚石棺与依山而建的石屋。在沉没城墙上方游泳，是这条海岸最具代表性的体验之一。

med-59.location: Kaş, Antalya, Türkiye · 土耳其安塔利亚卡什
med-59.intro: Patara was the principal port of Lycia and the seat of its league, with a triple-arched gate, colonnaded street, theatre and a lighthouse rebuilt in recent years. Beside the ruins stretches an 18-kilometre beach, one of Türkiye's longest, where loggerhead turtles nest. The site is also traditionally linked to the birth of St Nicholas.
med-59.introZh: 帕塔拉曾是吕基亚的主要港口与联盟所在地，拥有三拱城门、列柱大道、剧场和近年重建的灯塔。遗址旁是长达18公里的海滩，为土耳其最长海滩之一，也是蠵龟的产卵地。这里传统上还与圣尼古拉斯的出生地相关联。

med-60.intro: Fethiye is a lively harbour town built around a natural bay, with Lycian rock tombs carved into the cliff above the centre and a crusader castle on the hill. Its marina, promenade and fish market make it a base for gulet cruises, paragliding at Babadağ and trips to Ölüdeniz. The Tuesday market is one of the region's largest.
med-60.introZh: 费特希耶是围绕天然海湾发展的热闹港城，市中心上方崖壁刻有吕基亚岩墓，山丘上还有十字军城堡。游艇码头、海滨步道与鱼市使其成为帆船巡游、巴巴达山滑翔伞和厄吕代尼兹之旅的基地。周二集市是该地区规模最大的集市之一。

med-61.location: Fethiye, Muğla, Türkiye · 土耳其穆拉费特希耶
med-61.intro: Ölüdeniz is a sheltered lagoon of turquoise water backed by pine-covered mountains, widely regarded as one of the most beautiful beaches in Türkiye. It is also one of the world's top paragliding sites: pilots launch from Babadağ, nearly 2,000 metres above, and land on the beach. The lagoon is a protected nature reserve.
med-61.introZh: 厄吕代尼兹是背靠松林山脉的受庇护潟湖，碧绿海水被视为土耳其最美的海滩之一。这里也是世界顶级滑翔伞场地：飞行员从近2000米高的巴巴达山起飞，降落在海滩上。潟湖属于受保护的自然保护区。

med-62.location: Fethiye, Muğla, Türkiye · 土耳其穆拉费特希耶
med-62.intro: Butterfly Valley is a dramatic gorge enclosed by high cliffs, reached mainly by boat or a steep hiking trail. Its microclimate supports more than a hundred butterfly species, and a small waterfall, pebble beach and simple cabins sit at the bottom. The valley is protected and remains pleasantly undeveloped.
med-62.introZh: 蝴蝶谷是被高耸悬崖围合的壮观峡谷，主要靠船只或陡峭步道抵达。独特的微气候孕育百余种蝴蝶，谷底有小型瀑布、卵石海滩与简易木屋。山谷受到保护，至今仍保持着宜人的原始状态。

med-63.location: Seydikemer, Muğla, Türkiye · 土耳其穆拉塞伊迪凯梅尔
med-63.intro: Saklıkent Gorge is a narrow canyon cut by the Eşen river, with sheer walls up to 300 metres high and icy meltwater running through it. Visitors wade and scramble upstream on a wooden walkway, and the surrounding area offers rafting, zip-lining and trout restaurants. It is one of the most popular natural attractions between Fethiye and Kalkan.
med-63.introZh: 萨克勒肯特峡谷由埃申河切割而成，峡壁高达300米，冰冷的融水穿流其间。游客可沿木栈道涉水上行，周边还有漂流、滑索与鳟鱼餐馆。这里是费特希耶与卡尔坎之间最受欢迎的自然景点之一。

med-64.location: Ortaca, Muğla, Türkiye · 土耳其穆拉奥尔塔贾
med-64.intro: Dalyan is a riverside town famous for the Lycian rock tombs of Kaunos carved into the cliffs above the water. Boat trips wind through reed beds to İztuzu Beach, a long sand spit where loggerhead turtles nest, and to the mud baths and thermal springs. The area balances archaeology, wildlife and a laid-back resort atmosphere.
med-64.introZh: 达尔扬是河畔小镇，以水面崖壁上开凿的考诺斯吕基亚岩墓闻名。游船穿过芦苇荡驶向伊兹图祖海滩——蠵龟产卵的长长沙嘴，并通往泥浴与温泉。这里将考古、野生动物与悠闲度假氛围融为一体。

med-65.intro: Marmaris is a large resort and yachting harbour on a spectacular bay, backed by pine-covered hills. Its castle, old bazaar and long waterfront promenade sit beside a busy strip of hotels, restaurants and nightlife. It is a major departure point for gulet cruises along the Turquoise Coast and for ferries to Rhodes.
med-65.introZh: 马尔马里斯是坐落在壮丽海湾上的大型度假地与游艇港，背靠松林山丘。城堡、老巴扎与长长的海滨步道旁是密集的酒店、餐馆与夜生活。这里是土耳其蓝绿海岸帆船巡游的主要出发地，也有渡轮前往罗德岛。

med-66.location: Fethiye, Muğla, Türkiye · 土耳其穆拉费特希耶
med-66.intro: Göcek is a small marina town set among pine-clad islands and sheltered bays, widely considered one of the best sailing centres in the eastern Mediterranean. Its waterfront is lined with cafés and boutiques, and daily boat trips explore the Twelve Islands. The atmosphere is quieter and more polished than the larger resorts.
med-66.introZh: 格杰克是坐落在松林岛屿与隐蔽海湾之间的小型游艇小镇，被视为东地中海最佳帆船中心之一。海滨遍布咖啡馆与精品店，日常游船可探访“十二群岛”。与大型度假地相比，这里更安静、更精致。

med-67.location: Demre, Antalya, Türkiye · 土耳其安塔利亚代姆雷
med-67.intro: Myra was a Lycian city whose necropolis is carved into the cliffs above the plain, with house-shaped tombs and reliefs. Below lies the church of St Nicholas, built over the saint's tomb and later rebuilt by Byzantine emperors; its restored frescoes and sarcophagus attract pilgrims. The connection between St Nicholas and the modern Santa Claus began here.
med-67.introZh: 米拉是吕基亚城市，其墓地开凿在平原上方的崖壁，布满房屋形石墓与浮雕。山下是圣尼古拉教堂，建于圣人墓上，后由拜占庭皇帝重建；修复的壁画与石棺吸引众多朝圣者。圣尼古拉演变为现代圣诞老人的传说正源于此地。

med-68.location: Erdemli, Mersin, Türkiye · 土耳其梅尔辛埃尔代姆利
med-68.intro: Kızkalesi, the "Maiden's Castle", is a small Byzantine fortress built on a rocky island just offshore, linked to the legend of a princess protected from a prophecy. Inland, the Cennet and Cehennem sinkholes — "Heaven and Hell" — drop dramatically into the limestone, with a chapel inside the larger chasm and a winding path down.
med-68.introZh: “少女城堡”是建在近海岩岛上的小型拜占庭堡垒，传说与一位被预言所困的公主有关。内陆的“天堂洞”与“地狱洞”是陡然塌陷的石灰岩天坑，较大的洞底有一座小教堂，并有蜿蜒步道下行。

med-69.location: Mersin, Türkiye · 土耳其梅尔辛
med-69.intro: Tarsus is an ancient city of the Cilician plain, best known as the birthplace of St Paul and a meeting point of Roman, Byzantine and Ottoman history. Its landmarks include the St Paul's Well, the Roman road of Cleopatra's Gate, the Grand Mosque and the old bazaar. The nearby waterfalls and citrus groves make it an easy day trip from Mersin.
med-69.introZh: 塔尔苏斯是奇里乞亚平原上的古城，最著名的是圣保罗的出生地，也是罗马、拜占庭与奥斯曼历史的交汇点。圣保罗井、克利奥帕特拉门旁的罗马道路、大清真寺与老巴扎是主要看点。附近的瀑布与柑橘园使其成为梅尔辛周边轻松的一日游目的地。

med-70.location: Antakya, Hatay, Türkiye · 土耳其哈塔伊安塔基亚
med-70.intro: Antakya is ancient Antioch, one of the great cities of the Roman East, where followers of Jesus were first called Christians. The grotto church of St Pierre, a pilgrimage site, preserves traces of early worship, while the city's bazaar and cuisine reflect a rich Arab, Turkish and Christian heritage. The area is recovering after the devastating February 2023 earthquakes.
med-70.introZh: 安塔基亚即古代安条克，是罗马东方的重要城市，耶稣的门徒最早在此被称为“基督徒”。圣皮埃尔洞穴教堂是朝圣地，保存着早期礼拜痕迹；城市巴扎与饮食折射出阿拉伯、土耳其与基督教传统的交融。2023年2月大地震后，这里仍在艰难重建。

can-71.location: Nevşehir, Türkiye · 土耳其内夫谢希尔
can-71.intro: Cappadocia is a volcanic landscape of fairy chimneys, tuff cones and deep valleys, sculpted by erosion and used by communities for millennia. The UNESCO mixed property includes Göreme National Park and the rock-cut churches, monasteries and underground settlements of the region. Sunrise balloon flights over the valleys have become one of Türkiye's signature travel experiences.
can-71.introZh: 卡帕多奇亚是由火山凝灰岩经侵蚀形成的奇特地貌，遍布“仙女烟囱”、锥状岩与深谷，人类在此开凿居所已数千年。该世界文化与自然双重遗产包括格雷梅国家公园及周边的岩窟教堂、修道院与地下聚落。清晨乘热气球掠过山谷，已成为土耳其最具代表性的旅行体验之一。

can-72.location: Göreme, Nevşehir, Türkiye · 土耳其内夫谢希尔格雷梅
can-72.intro: The Göreme Open-Air Museum is a cluster of rock-cut monasteries and churches whose walls carry vivid ninth- to eleventh-century frescoes. The Dark Church, Apple Church and Buckle Church are among the finest, with scenes from the life of Christ painted in deep blues and reds. The site sits inside the Cappadocia World Heritage property and is its most visited monument.
can-72.introZh: 格雷梅露天博物馆是一片开凿于岩壁的修道院与教堂群，壁画多绘于9至11世纪，色彩鲜艳。黑暗教堂、苹果教堂与扣环教堂保存最佳，以深蓝与红色描绘基督生平。遗址位于卡帕多奇亚世界遗产范围内，是当地参观人数最多的古迹。

can-73.location: Uçhisar, Nevşehir, Türkiye · 土耳其内夫谢希尔乌奇希萨尔
can-73.intro: Uçhisar Castle is a natural rock citadel riddled with tunnels, rooms and windows, rising above the Cappadocian plateau as its highest point. The summit gives a wide panorama of Göreme, Avanos, Ürgüp and the distant Erciyes volcano. Sunset from the castle is a popular alternative to balloon flights.
can-73.introZh: 乌奇希萨尔城堡是一座布满隧道、房间与窗洞的天然岩石堡垒，是卡帕多奇亚高原的最高点。登顶可俯瞰格雷梅、阿瓦诺斯、于尔居普以及远处的埃尔吉耶斯火山。日落时分登城堡观景，是热气球之外的热门选择。

can-74.location: Derinkuyu, Nevşehir, Türkiye · 土耳其内夫谢希尔代林库尤
can-74.intro: Derinkuyu is the deepest excavated underground city in Cappadocia, descending about 60 metres through multiple levels. It contained stables, churches, storage rooms, kitchens, wine presses and ventilation shafts, and could shelter thousands of people during raids. Narrow tunnels and rolling stone doors reveal the engineering skill of its builders.
can-74.introZh: 代林库尤是卡帕多奇亚已发掘最深的地下城，向下延伸约60米，分为多层。城内有马厩、教堂、储藏室、厨房、榨酒池与通风井，战乱时可容纳数千人避难。狭窄隧道与滚石门展现了建造者高超的工程智慧。

can-75.location: Kaymaklı, Nevşehir, Türkiye · 土耳其内夫谢希尔凯马克勒
can-75.intro: Kaymaklı is one of the largest underground cities in Cappadocia, with eight levels open to visitors and a labyrinth of halls, stables, churches and storage rooms. It is less crowded than Derinkuyu and shows how entire communities could live below ground for long periods. The site is part of the wider Cappadocia World Heritage landscape.
can-75.introZh: 凯马克勒是卡帕多奇亚最大的地下城之一，目前开放八层，厅室、马厩、教堂与储藏间如迷宫般分布。这里比代林库尤清静，展示了整个社群如何长期在地下生活。遗址属于卡帕多奇亚世界遗产景观的一部分。

can-76.location: Nevşehir, Türkiye · 土耳其内夫谢希尔
can-76.intro: Paşabağ is a valley of multi-capped fairy chimneys, including a rock-cut chapel dedicated to St Simeon, while Devrent is known as the "Imagination Valley" for its animal-shaped rock formations. Both are classic Cappadocian landscapes and are easily combined with a drive through the Zelve and Göreme valleys.
can-76.introZh: 帕夏贝山谷以多顶“仙女烟囱”著称，其中一座岩窟小教堂供奉圣西蒙；德夫伦特则因岩石形似各种动物而被称为“想象谷”。两处都是卡帕多奇亚的经典景观，可与泽尔维、格雷梅山谷的自驾路线串联。

can-77.location: Nevşehir, Türkiye · 土耳其内夫谢希尔
can-77.intro: Avanos is a town on the Kızılırmak river, famous for its pottery workshops and for the red clay of the riverbank. Craftsmen still throw and paint ceramics in family ateliers, and the riverside promenade, old houses and suspension bridge make a pleasant break from the valleys. The town is also a centre for carpet weaving and wine.
can-77.introZh: 阿瓦诺斯位于克孜勒河畔，以制陶作坊与河岸红黏土闻名。工匠仍在家族工坊中拉坯、绘彩，河滨步道、老屋与吊桥为游览山谷之余提供轻松休憩。小镇也是地毯编织与葡萄酒的中心。

can-78.location: Nevşehir, Türkiye · 土耳其内夫谢希尔
can-78.intro: Ürgüp is a Cappadocian town of stone houses, cave hotels and wine houses, set below a rock outcrop with ancient dwellings. Its old streets, mosque and boutique hotels make it a popular base for exploring the region, and local wineries offer tastings of Cappadocian varieties. The surrounding valleys are dotted with churches and pigeon houses.
can-78.introZh: 于尔居普是卡帕多奇亚的石屋小镇，洞穴旅馆与酒馆林立，镇后岩丘上留有古代居所。老街区、清真寺与精品旅馆使其成为探索该地区的热门基地，当地酒庄可品尝卡帕多奇亚葡萄品种。周边山谷散布着教堂与鸽舍。

can-79.location: Güzelyurt, Aksaray, Türkiye · 土耳其阿克萨赖居泽尔尤尔特
can-79.intro: The Ihlara Valley is a green canyon cut by the Melendiz river, with rock-cut churches and dwellings hidden among poplars and orchards. A walking trail follows the stream past frescoed churches such as Ağaçaltı and Kokar, and riverside cafés offer tea and trout. It is one of the most peaceful corners of the Cappadocia region.
can-79.introZh: 伊赫拉拉峡谷是梅伦迪兹河切割出的绿色峡谷，杨树与果园间隐藏着岩窟教堂与居所。步道沿溪而行，经过阿阿奇阿尔特、科卡尔等绘有壁画的教堂，河畔咖啡馆供应茶与鳟鱼。这里是卡帕多奇亚地区最宁静的角落之一。

can-80.location: Güzelyurt, Aksaray, Türkiye · 土耳其阿克萨赖居泽尔尤尔特
can-80.intro: Selime Monastery is a vast rock-cut complex carved into a cliff above the Ihlara valley, with a cathedral-sized church, kitchens, cells and stables. Its facade of windows and tunnels resembles a fortress, and the site is thought to have housed a monastic community from the Byzantine period. The view over the valley is spectacular.
can-80.introZh: 塞利梅修道院是开凿在伊赫拉拉峡谷上方崖壁的巨大岩窟建筑群，拥有主教座堂规模的教堂、厨房、僧房与马厩。布满窗洞与隧道的立面宛如堡垒，据信拜占庭时期曾有修道团体在此生活。俯瞰峡谷的景色十分壮观。

can-81.location: Yeşilhisar, Kayseri, Türkiye · 土耳其开塞利耶希尔希萨尔
can-81.intro: Soğanlı Valley is a quieter Cappadocian valley with rock-cut churches, dovecotes and cave dwellings scattered among orchards. Its churches, such as the Snake Church and St Barbara, preserve frescoes from the ninth to thirteenth centuries. The valley is known for its rural atmosphere and fewer visitors.
can-81.introZh: 索安勒峡谷是较为清静的卡帕多奇亚山谷，岩窟教堂、鸽舍与洞穴居所散布在果园之间。蛇教堂、圣芭芭拉教堂等保存着9至13世纪的壁画。山谷以乡村气息与较少游客著称。

can-82.location: Konya, Türkiye · 土耳其科尼亚
can-82.intro: The Mevlana Museum centres on the turquoise-tiled tomb of Jalal al-Din Rumi, the thirteenth-century poet and founder of the Mevlevi Sufi order. Its rose garden, dervish cells, ritual hall and collection of manuscripts and instruments tell the story of the whirling dervishes. The museum is the spiritual heart of Konya and a major pilgrimage site.
can-82.introZh: 梅夫拉那博物馆以13世纪诗人、梅夫拉维苏菲教团创始人鲁米的绿松石色陵墓为核心。玫瑰园、德尔维希僧房、仪式厅以及手稿与乐器收藏，讲述着旋转舞僧的历史。博物馆是科尼亚的精神中心，也是重要朝圣地。

can-83.location: Konya, Türkiye · 土耳其科尼亚
can-83.intro: The Karatay Madrasa was founded in 1251 by the Seljuk vizier Celaleddin Karatay and now houses a museum of Seljuk tiles and ceramics. Its dome is covered with some of the finest turquoise and cobalt tilework in Anatolia, and the collection includes star-shaped tiles, mihrabs and inscriptions. It stands near the Mevlana Museum in the old Seljuk centre of Konya.
can-83.introZh: 卡拉泰神学院由塞尔柱大臣杰拉莱丁·卡拉泰于1251年创建，现为塞尔柱瓷砖与陶瓷博物馆。穹顶覆盖着安纳托利亚最精美的绿松石与钴蓝瓷砖，藏品包括星形砖、米哈拉布与铭文。神学院位于科尼亚老塞尔柱中心，靠近梅夫拉那博物馆。

can-84.location: Konya, Türkiye · 土耳其科尼亚
can-84.intro: Sille is an old village in a valley west of Konya, once home to a substantial Greek Orthodox community. Its cave churches, stone houses and the Church of Archangel Michael, now restored as a monument, lie among gardens and streams. The village offers a quiet contrast to the monumental centre of Konya.
can-84.introZh: 西莱是科尼亚以西山谷中的古老村落，曾居住着规模可观的希腊东正教社群。岩窟教堂、石屋与修复为古迹的圣米迦勒天使教堂散布在花园溪流之间。与科尼亚庄严的市中心相比，这里显得安静而质朴。

can-85.location: Çumra, Konya, Türkiye · 土耳其科尼亚丘姆拉
can-85.intro: Çatalhöyük is one of the world's oldest known proto-urban settlements, occupied from about 7400 to 6000 BC. Its mud-brick houses were packed together with no streets, entered through roofs, and decorated with wall paintings, bull horns and figurines. The site has yielded key evidence for the origins of agriculture, craft specialisation and complex society.
can-85.introZh: 加泰土丘是世界上已知最古老的原始城市聚落之一，约公元前7400至前6000年有人居住。土坯房屋紧密相连、没有街道，从屋顶进入，内部装饰着壁画、牛角与雕像。遗址为农业起源、手工业分工与复杂社会的形成提供了关键证据。

can-86.location: Beyşehir, Konya, Türkiye · 土耳其科尼亚贝伊谢希尔
can-86.intro: The Eşrefoğlu Mosque in Beyşehir is one of five medieval wooden hypostyle mosques inscribed by UNESCO in 2023. Built in the late thirteenth century, it is famous for its forest of carved timber columns, painted ceiling and a dome over the mihrab. The mosque stands near the shore of Lake Beyşehir and the old town.
can-86.introZh: 贝伊谢希尔的埃什雷弗奥卢清真寺是2023年列入世界遗产的五座中世纪木柱清真寺之一。清真寺建于13世纪末，以密集的雕花木柱、彩绘天花与米哈拉布上方的穹顶闻名。它位于贝伊谢希尔湖岸与老城附近。

can-87.location: Ankara, Türkiye · 土耳其安卡拉
can-87.intro: Anıtkabir is the mausoleum of Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, founder of the Turkish Republic, set on a hill above Ankara. Its monumental approach, Hall of Honour and museum of Atatürk's life combine modern architecture with Seljuk and Ottoman motifs. The changing of the guard and the ceremonial plaza make it a place of national pilgrimage.
can-87.introZh: 阿塔图尔克陵墓是土耳其共和国缔造者穆斯塔法·凯末尔·阿塔图尔克的陵寝，坐落于安卡拉山丘之上。纪念性大道、荣誉厅与阿塔图尔克生平博物馆将现代建筑与塞尔柱、奥斯曼纹样结合。卫兵换岗与仪式广场使其成为国家朝圣之地。

can-88.location: Ankara, Türkiye · 土耳其安卡拉
can-88.intro: Housed in a restored Ottoman bedesten in Ankara's old quarter, the Museum of Anatolian Civilizations traces Anatolia from the Palaeolithic to the classical period. Its collections of Hittite reliefs, Phrygian objects, Neolithic wall paintings and the famous mother-goddess figurine from Çatalhöyük are among the finest in Türkiye. The museum was European Museum of the Year in 1997.
can-88.introZh: 安纳托利亚文明博物馆位于安卡拉老城一座修复的奥斯曼室内市场内，按时间顺序展示从旧石器时代到古典时期的安纳托利亚文明。赫梯浮雕、弗里吉亚器物、新石器时代壁画以及著名的加泰土丘母神小像，都是土耳其最精美的藏品。该馆曾获1997年欧洲年度博物馆奖。

can-89.location: Ankara, Türkiye · 土耳其安卡拉
can-89.intro: Ankara Castle crowns a hill above the old city, with Byzantine and Seljuk walls and panoramic views over modern Ankara. Below its walls, the Hamamönü quarter preserves restored Ottoman houses, a mosque and cafés, while the nearby citadel lanes are filled with antique shops and local food. The area shows the layered history beneath the capital's modern grid.
can-89.introZh: 安卡拉城堡雄踞老城山丘，保存拜占庭与塞尔柱城墙，可俯瞰现代安卡拉全景。城墙下的哈马莫尼街区保留着修复的奥斯曼老屋、清真寺与咖啡馆，城堡内的街巷则布满古董店与地方小吃。这里展现了现代首都网格之下层叠的历史。

can-90.location: Polatlı, Ankara, Türkiye · 土耳其安卡拉波拉特勒
can-90.intro: Gordion was the capital of the Phrygian kingdom and the place where Alexander the Great cut the legendary Gordian Knot. Its huge burial mounds, including the Midas Mound, and the citadel with its early monumental buildings are among the most important Phrygian remains. UNESCO inscribed the site in 2023.
can-90.introZh: 戈尔迪翁是弗里吉亚王国的首都，也是亚历山大大帝砍断“戈尔迪乌姆之结”传说的发生地。巨大的王陵土丘（包括迈达斯土丘）与拥有早期纪念性建筑的卫城，是弗里吉亚文明最重要的遗存之一。2023年列入世界遗产。

can-91.location: Ankara, Türkiye · 土耳其安卡拉
can-91.intro: The Ahi Şerafeddin Mosque, also called Arslanhane Mosque, is a thirteenth-century wooden hypostyle mosque in Ankara's old citadel quarter. Its flat ceiling rests on rows of carved timber columns, some reused from older buildings, and the mihrab is decorated with Seljuk tiles. It is one of five mosques in the UNESCO serial property inscribed in 2023.
can-91.introZh: 阿希·谢拉费丁清真寺又称阿尔斯兰哈内清真寺，是安卡拉老城堡区内的13世纪木柱清真寺。平顶天花由一排排雕花木柱支撑，部分柱子取自更早的建筑，米哈拉布饰有塞尔柱瓷砖。它是2023年列入世界遗产的五座木柱清真寺之一。

can-92.location: Eskişehir, Türkiye · 土耳其埃斯基谢希尔
can-92.intro: Odunpazarı is the historic quarter of Eskişehir, a hillside of colourful Ottoman houses, cobbled lanes and small museums. Its restored buildings now house cafés, galleries and shops, including museums of glass, wood and contemporary art. The area is a lively example of Turkish urban conservation and a pleasant contrast to the modern city below.
can-92.introZh: 奥登帕扎勒是埃斯基谢希尔的历史街区，山坡上散布着色彩鲜艳的奥斯曼房屋、石板路与小博物馆。修复后的建筑现为咖啡馆、画廊与商店，还有玻璃、木艺与当代艺术博物馆。这里是土耳其城市保护的成功范例，与现代城区形成有趣对比。

can-93.location: Sivrihisar, Eskişehir, Türkiye · 土耳其埃斯基谢希尔西夫里希萨尔
can-93.intro: The Ulu Cami of Sivrihisar is a thirteenth-century wooden hypostyle mosque, one of five included in the 2023 UNESCO serial property. Its wide prayer hall is supported by more than sixty carved wooden columns, and the building preserves Seljuk-era stone and woodwork. The small town also has an attractive old bazaar and preserved Ottoman houses.
can-93.introZh: 西夫里希萨尔大清真寺是13世纪木柱清真寺，为2023年世界遗产系列申报的五座之一。宽阔的礼拜厅由六十多根雕花木柱支撑，建筑保存了塞尔柱时期的石作与木作。小镇还有颇具风情的古老巴扎与奥斯曼老屋。

can-94.location: Divriği, Sivas, Türkiye · 土耳其锡瓦斯迪夫里伊
can-94.intro: The Great Mosque and Hospital of Divriği were built in the thirteenth century under the Mengüjek emirs and are celebrated for their extraordinary stone-carved portals. Their geometric, floral and figurative reliefs are among the masterpieces of Islamic stonework, and the complex includes a mosque, hospital, tomb and fountain. It was one of Türkiye's first UNESCO World Heritage sites, inscribed in 1985.
can-94.introZh: 迪夫里伊大清真寺与医院由门居杰克埃米尔于13世纪建造，以极其精美的石雕大门闻名。几何、花卉与人物浮雕是伊斯兰石作的杰作，建筑群包括清真寺、医院、陵墓与喷泉。它是土耳其最早列入世界遗产的项目之一，1985年入选。

can-95.location: Sivas, Türkiye · 土耳其锡瓦斯
can-95.intro: Sivas was an important Seljuk city on the Silk Road, and its historic centre preserves the Gök Medrese with its blue-tiled portal, the Ulu Cami, the Şifaiye Madrasa and the covered bazaar. The city is also known for its thermal springs and for hosting the Congress of Sivas in 1919, a milestone of the Turkish War of Independence.
can-95.introZh: 锡瓦斯是丝绸之路上的重要塞尔柱城市，老城保存着蓝色瓷砖大门的戈克神学院、大清真寺、希法耶神学院与室内巴扎。城市还以温泉闻名，1919年土耳其独立战争关键节点锡瓦斯大会也在此召开。

can-96.location: Kayseri, Türkiye · 土耳其开塞利
can-96.intro: Erciyes is a 3,917-metre dormant volcano rising above Kayseri, with ski slopes on its northern flank and alpine trails in summer. The mountain is visible from much of Cappadocia and has shaped the region's volcanic landscape. Its ski resort offers facilities for beginners and advanced skiers within easy reach of the city.
can-96.introZh: 埃尔吉耶斯山是海拔3917米的休眠火山，耸立于开塞利之上，北坡设有滑雪场，夏季则有高山步道。从卡帕多奇亚大片地区都能望见这座山，它也塑造了该地区的火山地貌。滑雪场距离市区不远，适合初学者与高级滑雪者。

can-97.location: Kayseri, Türkiye · 土耳其开塞利
can-97.intro: Kayseri's historic bazaar is a vast covered quarter of hans, shops and food stalls beneath the Seljuk citadel, known for pastırma, sucuk and traditional crafts. Nearby Kültepe (Kanesh) was an important Assyrian trading colony in the early second millennium BC, where thousands of cuneiform tablets were found. Together they connect the city's Ottoman commerce with Anatolia's deepest history.
can-97.introZh: 开塞利老巴扎是塞尔柱城堡下方庞大的室内商业区，客栈、店铺与小吃摊林立，以帕斯特尔玛腌肉、苏朱克香肠与传统手工艺闻名。附近的库尔泰佩（卡尼什）是公元前两千年初重要的亚述贸易殖民地，出土了数千块楔形文字泥板。两者将城市的奥斯曼商业与安纳托利亚更深层的历史连接起来。

can-98.location: Aksaray/Ankara, Türkiye · 土耳其阿克萨赖/安卡拉
can-98.intro: Lake Tuz is one of the largest hypersaline lakes in the world, a shallow white expanse in the middle of the Anatolian plateau. In spring, rainfall and minerals turn parts of the lake pink, attracting photographers, and the salt flats are harvested commercially. The lake is an important habitat for flamingos and other waterbirds.
can-98.introZh: 图兹湖是世界上最大的超盐湖之一，位于安纳托利亚高原中部，是一片浅而洁白的盐滩。春季雨水与矿物质使部分湖面泛出粉红色，吸引众多摄影者，盐壳也被商业开采。湖泊是火烈鸟等水鸟的重要栖息地。

bls-99.location: Boğazkale, Çorum, Türkiye · 土耳其乔鲁姆博阿兹卡莱
bls-99.intro: Hattusha was the capital of the Hittite Empire from the seventeenth to the twelfth centuries BC, a great Anatolian power that rivalled Egypt. Its massive walls, Lion Gate, King's Gate, Great Temple and the royal acropolis are spread across a rocky plateau, while the nearby rock sanctuary of Yazılıkaya preserves reliefs of gods and kings. The site was inscribed by UNESCO in 1986.
bls-99.introZh: 哈图沙是公元前17至前12世纪赫梯帝国的首都，这个安纳托利亚强国曾与埃及争雄。巨大的城墙、狮门、王门、大神庙与王室卫城分布在岩石高原上，附近的亚兹勒卡亚岩壁圣所保存着神祇与国王浮雕。1986年列入世界遗产。

bls-100.location: Alaca, Çorum, Türkiye · 土耳其乔鲁姆阿拉贾
bls-100.intro: Alacahöyük is an archaeological mound with occupation from the Chalcolithic period to the Hittite era. Its royal tombs contained gold, bronze and iron objects of remarkable craftsmanship, and the Hittite gate is flanked by carved sphinxes and a relief of a king and priest. The site lies close to Hattusha and is often visited together with it.
bls-100.introZh: 阿拉贾赫于克是自铜石并用时代延续至赫梯时期的考古土丘。王室墓葬出土了工艺精湛的金、青铜与铁器，赫梯城门两侧立有狮身人面像与国王、祭司浮雕。遗址距哈图沙不远，常与哈图沙一同参观。

bls-101.location: Safranbolu, Karabük, Türkiye · 土耳其卡拉比克番红花城
bls-101.intro: Safranbolu is a beautifully preserved Ottoman town of timber-framed houses, cobbled lanes and historic hans, set in a valley inland from the Black Sea. Its traditional houses, mosques, fountains and guild buildings reflect Ottoman urban life from the eighteenth to twentieth centuries. The town gave its name to saffron and was inscribed by UNESCO in 1994.
bls-101.introZh: 番红花城是保存极佳的奥斯曼小镇，木构架房屋、石板街巷与历史客栈坐落于黑海内陆山谷。传统宅邸、清真寺、喷泉与行会建筑展现了18至20世纪的奥斯曼城市生活。小镇因番红花得名，1994年列入世界遗产。

bls-102.location: Amasra, Bartın, Türkiye · 土耳其巴尔滕阿马斯腊
bls-102.intro: Amasra is a small Black Sea port built on a peninsula and an island, with a Byzantine castle, old walls and two sandy bays. Its fish restaurants, quiet streets and sea views make it a popular weekend escape, and the nearby beaches and forests offer walking and swimming. The town was known in antiquity as Amastris.
bls-102.introZh: 阿马斯腊是建在半岛与小岛上的黑海小港，拥有拜占庭城堡、古城墙与两片沙滩海湾。海鲜餐馆、安静街巷与海景使其成为热门周末度假地，附近的海滩与森林适合徒步与游泳。小镇在古代称为阿马斯特里斯。

bls-103.location: Kastamonu, Türkiye · 土耳其卡斯塔莫努
bls-103.intro: Kastamonu is an old Anatolian town of stone houses, mosques and a covered bazaar, and the nearby village of Kasaba holds the Mahmut Bey Mosque, built in 1366. The mosque is one of five wooden hypostyle mosques inscribed by UNESCO in 2023, celebrated for its carved columns and painted ceiling. The town itself preserves a rich Seljuk and Ottoman heritage.
bls-103.introZh: 卡斯塔莫努是安纳托利亚古城，石屋、清真寺与室内巴扎保存完好；附近卡萨巴村的马赫穆特贝伊清真寺建于1366年，以雕花木柱与彩绘天花闻名，是2023年列入世界遗产的五座木柱清真寺之一。小镇本身也保存着丰富的塞尔柱与奥斯曼遗产。

bls-104.location: Sinop, Türkiye · 土耳其锡诺普
bls-104.intro: Sinop occupies a rocky peninsula on the Black Sea, the northernmost point of Anatolia, with a Byzantine castle, ancient walls and a harbour sheltered by the headland. The town is associated with the ancient philosopher Diogenes and has long, quiet beaches nearby. Its seafood restaurants and relaxed pace make it a pleasant stop on the Black Sea coast.
bls-104.introZh: 锡诺普位于黑海岩石半岛，是安纳托利亚最北端，拥有拜占庭城堡、古城墙与受岬角庇护的港口。小镇与古代哲学家第欧根尼有关，附近有绵长安静的海滩。海鲜餐馆与悠闲节奏使其成为黑海海岸宜人的一站。

bls-105.location: Amasya, Türkiye · 土耳其阿马西亚
bls-105.intro: Amasya is a river town famous for the rock-cut tombs of the Pontic kings carved into the cliffs above the Yeşilırmak, and for its Ottoman timber houses along the water. The city was an important centre in Hellenistic, Roman and Ottoman times, and its museums, mosques and riverside promenade make it one of the most attractive towns of the Black Sea interior.
bls-105.introZh: 阿马西亚是河畔古城，以耶希尔河上方崖壁开凿的本都王陵闻名，沿河还保存着奥斯曼木屋。城市在希腊化、罗马与奥斯曼时期均为重镇，博物馆、清真寺与河滨步道使其成为黑海内陆最具魅力的城镇之一。

bls-106.location: Samsun, Türkiye · 土耳其萨姆松
bls-106.intro: Samsun is the largest city on the Turkish Black Sea coast and the place where Mustafa Kemal Atatürk landed in 1919 to begin the War of Independence. Its Amisos Hill has archaeological remains and a panoramic view, and the city's museums, promenade and nearby delta wetlands attract visitors. It is a practical gateway to the central Black Sea region.
bls-106.introZh: 萨姆松是土耳其黑海沿岸最大城市，1919年穆斯塔法·凯末尔·阿塔图尔克在此登陆，揭开独立战争序幕。阿米索斯山留有考古遗迹并可俯瞰全景，城市博物馆、海滨步道与附近三角洲湿地吸引游客。这里是前往黑海中部地区的实用门户。

bls-107.location: Ordu, Türkiye · 土耳其奥尔杜
bls-107.intro: Boztepe is a hill above Ordu with a cable car, tea gardens and a wide panorama over the Black Sea and the hazelnut-covered hills. It is a popular sunset spot and a good place to experience the region's tea culture. The surrounding countryside is known for hazelnut orchards and highland pastures.
bls-107.introZh: 博兹特佩是奥尔杜上方的山丘，设有缆车、茶园，可俯瞰黑海与遍布榛树林的山丘。这里是热门日落观景点，也是体验当地茶文化的好去处。周边乡村以榛子园与高山牧场闻名。

bls-108.location: Giresun, Türkiye · 土耳其吉雷松
bls-108.intro: Giresun is a Black Sea town set below green mountains, known as the hazelnut capital of Türkiye. Its castle on a rocky headland, the nearby Giresun Island with its chapel ruins, and the long seafront make it a quiet base for exploring the eastern Black Sea. The surrounding highlands offer yayla pastures and waterfalls.
bls-108.introZh: 吉雷松是坐落于青山之下的黑海城镇，被称为土耳其的榛子之都。岩石岬角上的城堡、附近留有教堂废墟的吉雷松岛以及长长的海滨，使其成为探索东黑海的安静基地。周边高地有高山牧场与瀑布。

bls-109.location: Trabzon, Türkiye · 土耳其特拉布宗
bls-109.intro: Trabzon Hagia Sophia is a thirteenth-century Byzantine church built by the Komnenos dynasty of the Empire of Trebizond, standing on a bluff above the Black Sea. Its dome, frescoes and stone reliefs show a distinctive Pontic style, and the building served as a mosque and museum before becoming a mosque again. The garden offers fine sea views.
bls-109.introZh: 特拉布宗圣索菲亚是13世纪拜占庭教堂，由特拉布宗帝国的科穆宁王朝建造，矗立于黑海之上的崖顶。穹顶、壁画与石雕呈现出独特的本都风格，建筑先后作为清真寺、博物馆，后又恢复为清真寺。花园可眺望海景。

bls-110.location: Maçka, Trabzon, Türkiye · 土耳其特拉布宗马奇卡
bls-110.intro: Sümela Monastery clings to a sheer cliff in the Altındere valley, founded in the fourth century and expanded by the Komnenoi. Its painted courtyard church, rock-cut cells and aqueduct are reached by a steep path and stairs, with forested mountains all around. Restoration has affected access at times, but the setting remains one of the most dramatic in Türkiye.
bls-110.introZh: 苏梅拉修道院紧贴阿尔滕德雷峡谷的陡崖而建，始建于4世纪，后由科穆宁王朝扩建。彩绘的庭院教堂、岩窟僧房与引水渠需经陡峭步道和台阶抵达，四周森林覆盖。修复期间开放曾受影响，但其所处环境仍是土耳其最壮观的之一。

bls-111.location: Çaykara, Trabzon, Türkiye · 土耳其特拉布宗恰伊卡拉
bls-111.intro: Uzungöl is a mountain lake surrounded by dense forest, wooden houses and steep valleys, reached by a scenic road south of Trabzon. It has become a popular domestic resort, with lakeside walks, trout restaurants and views of the surrounding peaks. Morning mist and autumn colours make it especially photogenic.
bls-111.introZh: 乌宗湖是群山环抱的森林湖泊，四周木屋与陡峭山谷环绕，从特拉布宗沿风景公路南行可达。这里已成为热门国内度假地，有环湖步道、鳟鱼餐馆与群峰景色。晨雾与秋色使其格外上镜。

bls-112.location: Çamlıhemşin, Rize, Türkiye · 土耳其里泽恰姆勒赫姆欣
bls-112.intro: Ayder is a highland plateau in the Kaçkar Mountains, known for its wooden yayla houses, hot springs and green pastures. It is a base for trekking to glacier lakes and high passes, and the surrounding villages preserve the culture of the Hemşin people. Summer brings cool air and alpine flowers.
bls-112.introZh: 艾德尔是卡奇卡尔山中的高原牧场，以木造高山房屋、温泉与绿色草甸闻名。这里是徒步前往冰川湖与高山垭口的基地，周边村落保留着赫姆欣人的文化。夏季气候凉爽，高山花卉盛开。

bls-113.location: Rize/Artvin, Türkiye · 土耳其里泽/阿尔特温
bls-113.intro: The Kaçkar Mountains form a dramatic range along the eastern Black Sea, with glaciated peaks, alpine lakes and traditional yayla settlements. Trekking routes link villages and high pastures, and the range is one of Türkiye's premier areas for hiking and nature photography. The highest peak rises to 3,937 metres.
bls-113.introZh: 卡奇卡尔山脉沿东黑海延伸，拥有冰川峰、高山湖泊与传统的夏季牧场聚落。徒步路线连接村庄与高地草场，是土耳其首屈一指的徒步与自然摄影地区。最高峰海拔3937米。

bls-114.intro: Rize is the centre of Turkish tea production, its steep hillsides covered with terraced tea gardens that turn bright green in spring. Visitors can tour tea factories, walk through the plantations and sample freshly brewed çay in roadside tea houses. The misty, rainy climate is essential to the region's tea culture.
bls-114.introZh: 里泽是土耳其茶叶生产中心，陡峭山坡覆盖着梯田式茶园，春季一片嫩绿。游客可参观茶厂、漫步茶园，在路边茶馆品尝新泡的红茶。多雾多雨的气候是当地茶文化赖以存在的基础。

bls-115.intro: Abant Lake is a mountain lake in a protected nature park, surrounded by pine forests and meadows about two hours from Istanbul and Ankara. A walking and cycling path circles the lake, and horse riding, picnics and small hotels make it a popular weekend retreat. Autumn colours are particularly striking.
bls-115.introZh: 阿班特湖是受保护自然公园中的高山湖泊，四周松林与草甸环绕，距伊斯坦布尔和安卡拉约两小时车程。环湖步道适合步行与骑行，骑马、野餐与小型旅馆使其成为热门周末度假地。秋季色彩尤为迷人。

bls-116.intro: Yedigöller means "seven lakes", a national park of forested hills and small lakes formed by landslides and streams. Walking trails connect the lakes, and the park is especially famous for its autumn foliage. Camping and simple cabins allow visitors to stay overnight in the quiet woods.
bls-116.introZh: “耶迪格勒”意为“七湖”，是国家公园，以森林山丘与由滑坡、溪流形成的小湖群著称。步道连接各湖，秋季红叶尤为著名。园区提供露营与简易木屋，可在静谧森林中过夜。

bls-117.location: Şavşat, Artvin, Türkiye · 土耳其阿尔特温沙夫沙特
bls-117.intro: Karagöl Sahara is a high-altitude lake in the forests of Artvin, near the Georgian border, surrounded by fir trees and steep mountains. The name "Sahara" refers to a sandy shoreline rather than a desert, and the lake is a tranquil spot for walking and picnics. The surrounding villages offer glimpses of Georgian-influenced local culture.
bls-117.introZh: 撒哈拉卡拉格尔是阿尔特温森林中的高山湖泊，靠近格鲁吉亚边境，四周冷杉与陡峭山脉环绕。名称中的“撒哈拉”指沙质湖岸，而非沙漠；湖泊宁静，适合散步与野餐。周边村落可见受格鲁吉亚影响的当地文化。

ean-118.location: Ocaklı, Kars, Türkiye · 土耳其卡尔斯奥贾克利
ean-118.intro: Ani was the capital of the medieval Armenian kingdom of the Bagratids and a great Silk Road city, now a haunting ruin on a plateau above the Arpa river gorge. Its walls, cathedral, churches, caravanserai and mosque stand in a windswept landscape on the closed border with Armenia. UNESCO inscribed the site in 2016 for its outstanding medieval architecture.
ean-118.introZh: 阿尼是中世纪亚美尼亚巴格拉图尼王国的首都与丝绸之路重镇，如今是阿尔帕河峡谷上方高原上的苍凉废墟。城墙、主教座堂、教堂、商队客栈与清真寺矗立在紧邻亚美尼亚边境的风蚀荒原上。2016年因其杰出的中世纪建筑列入世界遗产。

ean-119.location: Kars, Türkiye · 土耳其卡尔斯
ean-119.intro: Kars is a grid-plan city of Baltic-style stone buildings, shaped by its Russian imperial past in the nineteenth century. Its castle overlooks the town, and the surrounding highlands produce cheese and honey; the city is the gateway to Ani. Winter brings snow and a stark, atmospheric beauty to its wide streets.
ean-119.introZh: 卡尔斯是呈网格布局的城市，19世纪俄国帝国时期留下的波罗的海风格石建筑塑造了它的面貌。城堡俯瞰全城，周边高地出产奶酪与蜂蜜；这里是前往阿尼的门户。冬季白雪覆盖，宽阔街道呈现苍凉而独特的美感。

ean-120.location: Erzurum, Türkiye · 土耳其埃尔祖鲁姆
ean-120.intro: Erzurum is a high plateau city at about 1,900 metres, with a Seljuk heritage of madrasas, mosques and a covered bazaar. Its Çifte Minareli Madrasa and Yakutiye Madrasa are among the finest Seljuk monuments in Anatolia, and the nearby Palandöken mountains make it a winter sports centre. The city is a gateway to eastern Anatolia.
ean-120.introZh: 埃尔祖鲁姆是海拔约1900米的高原城市，拥有塞尔柱时期的神学院、清真寺与室内巴扎。双宣礼塔神学院与雅库蒂耶神学院是安纳托利亚最精美的塞尔柱建筑之一，附近的帕兰德肯山使其成为冬季运动中心。城市是东安纳托利亚的门户。

ean-121.location: Erzurum, Türkiye · 土耳其埃尔祖鲁姆
ean-121.intro: Palandöken is a ski resort on the mountain above Erzurum, with long runs, modern lifts and reliable snow from December to April. It hosted events during the 2011 Winter Universiade and is popular with Turkish skiers for its dry powder and high altitude. In summer the slopes become hiking and mountain-biking terrain.
ean-121.introZh: 帕兰德肯是埃尔祖鲁姆上方山区的滑雪场，拥有长雪道、现代缆车，12月至次年4月雪况稳定。这里曾承办2011年冬季世界大学生运动会，以干燥粉雪与高海拔受到土耳其滑雪者欢迎。夏季山坡则成为徒步与山地自行车场地。

ean-122.intro: Van Castle is a vast Urartian fortress built on a limestone outcrop above the ruins of ancient Tushpa, with cuneiform inscriptions, rock-cut tombs and foundations of temples and palaces. The site overlooks Lake Van and the modern city, and the surrounding landscape includes Urartian rock monuments. It is one of the most important remains of the Urartian kingdom.
ean-122.introZh: 凡城城堡是建在石灰岩高地上的巨大乌拉尔图堡垒，下方是古代图什帕遗址，存有楔形文字铭文、岩窟陵墓与神庙宫殿基址。城堡俯瞰凡湖与现代城市，周边还有乌拉尔图岩刻遗迹。这里是乌拉尔图王国最重要的遗存之一。

ean-123.location: Gevaş, Van, Türkiye · 土耳其凡城盖瓦什
ean-123.intro: Akdamar Church stands on a small island in Lake Van, built in the tenth century as the palace church of the Armenian kingdom of Vaspurakan. Its exterior is covered with carved reliefs of biblical scenes and animals, and the interior preserves fragments of frescoes. Boats run from the mainland to the island, which is a protected monument.
ean-123.introZh: 阿克达玛教堂位于凡湖小岛上，建于10世纪，是亚美尼亚瓦斯普拉坎王国的宫廷教堂。外墙布满圣经故事与动物的浮雕，内部保存壁画残片。游船从大陆驶往这座受保护的古迹。

ean-124.location: Muradiye, Van, Türkiye · 土耳其凡城穆拉迪耶
ean-124.intro: The Muradiye Waterfalls are a series of cascades on the Bendimahi river northeast of Lake Van, set among orchards and poplar trees. The area is a popular picnic and tea spot, with simple restaurants and walking paths. It is often combined with a circuit of Lake Van and the surrounding mountains.
ean-124.introZh: 穆拉迪耶瀑布是凡湖东北本迪马希河上的一系列跌水，四周果园与杨树环绕。这里是热门野餐与喝茶地点，有简易餐馆与步道。常与凡湖及周边山脉的环线游览组合。

ean-125.location: Doğubayazıt, Ağrı, Türkiye · 土耳其阿勒多乌巴亚泽特
ean-125.intro: İshak Pasha Palace is a sprawling Ottoman palace built on a rocky terrace in the eighteenth century, with a mix of Seljuk, Ottoman, Persian and Georgian architectural elements. Its courtyards, harem, mosque and dungeon overlook the plain, with Mount Ararat rising behind. It is one of the most spectacular monuments of eastern Türkiye.
ean-125.introZh: 伊沙克帕夏宫是18世纪建在岩石台地上的奥斯曼宫殿，融合塞尔柱、奥斯曼、波斯与格鲁吉亚建筑元素。庭院、后宫、清真寺与地牢俯瞰平原，亚拉拉特山在背后耸立。它是土耳其东部最壮观的古迹之一。

ean-126.location: Iğdır/Ağrı, Türkiye · 土耳其厄德尔/阿勒
ean-126.intro: Mount Ararat is a snow-capped volcanic massif of 5,137 metres, the highest peak in Türkiye and traditionally associated with the landing of Noah's Ark. The mountain dominates the horizon of eastern Anatolia and is climbed by guided expeditions from Doğubayazıt and Iğdır, usually in summer. Permits and guides are required.
ean-126.introZh: 亚拉拉特山是海拔5137米的雪顶火山群，为土耳其最高峰，传统上与诺亚方舟登陆地相关联。山体主导着东安纳托利亚的天际线，通常夏季从多乌巴亚泽特和厄德尔随向导攀登。登山需许可证与向导。

ean-127.location: Battalgazi, Malatya, Türkiye · 土耳其马拉蒂亚巴塔尔加齐
ean-127.intro: Arslantepe is a tell near Malatya with occupation from the Chalcolithic period to the Iron Age, and one of the earliest known palace complexes in the world. Excavations have yielded royal tombs, administrative archives and the oldest swords yet discovered, dating to around 3000 BC. UNESCO inscribed the mound in 2021.
ean-127.introZh: 阿尔斯兰特佩是马拉蒂亚附近的考古土丘，从铜石并用时代延续至铁器时代，拥有世界上最早的宫殿建筑群之一。发掘出土了王室墓葬、行政档案以及迄今发现最早的剑，年代约公元前3000年。2021年列入世界遗产。

ean-128.location: Malatya, Türkiye · 土耳其马拉蒂亚
ean-128.intro: Malatya is the apricot capital of Türkiye, its orchards spreading across the fertile plain below the Taurus mountains. The city has a long history reaching back to the Hittite era and preserves bazaars, mosques and a museum with finds from Arslantepe. It is recovering from the February 2023 earthquakes, which damaged much of the region.
ean-128.introZh: 马拉蒂亚是土耳其的杏子之都，果园遍布托罗斯山下的肥沃平原。城市历史可追溯至赫梯时代，保存着巴扎、清真寺以及收藏阿尔斯兰特佩出土文物的博物馆。2023年2月大地震重创该地区，城市仍在恢复之中。

ean-129.location: Elazığ, Türkiye · 土耳其埃拉泽
ean-129.intro: Hazar Lake is a mountain lake south of Elazığ, set in a valley of rocky hills and vineyards. Its shoreline is lined with cafés and picnic areas, and the lake is a local centre for swimming, boating and relaxed weekends. The surrounding region is known for its vineyards and traditional cuisine.
ean-129.introZh: 哈扎尔湖位于埃拉泽以南的山谷中，四周岩石山丘与葡萄园环绕。湖岸遍布咖啡馆与野餐区，是当地人游泳、划船与休闲周末的中心。周边地区以葡萄园与传统饮食闻名。

ean-130.location: Kemaliye, Erzincan, Türkiye · 土耳其埃尔津詹凯马利耶
ean-130.intro: Kemaliye is a stone-built town in a deep gorge of the Euphrates, connected to the outside world by a dramatic road tunnel and narrow mountain roads. Its traditional houses, dark church and riverside setting attract travellers seeking a remote Anatolian town. Outdoor activities include rafting and canyon walks.
ean-130.introZh: 凯马利耶是建在幼发拉底河深谷中的石造小镇，通过壮观的公路隧道与狭窄山路与外界相连。传统石屋、黑暗教堂与河畔环境吸引着寻找偏远安纳托利亚小镇的旅行者。户外活动包括漂流与峡谷徒步。

san-131.location: Kahta, Adıyaman, Türkiye · 土耳其阿德亚曼卡赫塔
san-131.intro: Nemrut Dağ is a 2,150-metre mountain topped by the tomb-sanctuary of King Antiochus I of Commagene, built in the first century BC. Colossal seated statues of gods and kings, their heads now toppled from the bodies, flank a pyramidal tumulus, with reliefs of Persian and Greek deities. Sunrise and sunset from the summit are famously spectacular.
san-131.introZh: 内姆鲁特山海拔2150米，山顶是公元前1世纪科马基尼国王安条克一世的陵墓圣所。巨大的神祇与国王坐像分列金字塔形土丘两侧，头像现已与身体分离散落，周围还有波斯与希腊神祇浮雕。山顶的日出与日落景色极为壮观。

san-132.location: Diyarbakır, Türkiye · 土耳其迪亚巴克尔
san-132.intro: Diyarbakır's fortress is a vast circuit of black basalt walls, towers and gates dating largely to the Roman and Byzantine periods and later strengthened by Islamic rulers. Below the walls, the Hevsel Gardens form a fertile green belt along the Tigris, irrigated for centuries and still cultivated. The property was inscribed by UNESCO in 2015.
san-132.introZh: 迪亚巴克尔城堡由黑色玄武岩城墙、塔楼与城门组成，主体可追溯至罗马与拜占庭时期，后经伊斯兰统治者加固。城墙下方的赫夫塞尔花园沿底格里斯河形成肥沃绿带，数百年灌溉耕作延续至今。2015年列入世界遗产。

san-133.location: Diyarbakır, Türkiye · 土耳其迪亚巴克尔
san-133.intro: The Ulu Cami of Diyarbakır is one of the oldest mosques in Anatolia, converted from a Byzantine church in the seventh century and rebuilt in the Seljuk period. Its courtyard, fountain and carved stone facades sit within the Sur district, a maze of black-basalt lanes, hans and churches inside the fortress walls. The area is being restored after conflict and earthquake damage.
san-133.introZh: 迪亚巴克尔大清真寺是安纳托利亚最古老的清真寺之一，7世纪由拜占庭教堂改建，塞尔柱时期重修。庭院、喷泉与石雕立面位于苏尔区——城堡墙内由黑色玄武岩街巷、客栈与教堂组成的迷宫。该地区在冲突与地震后仍在修复。

san-134.location: Şanlıurfa, Türkiye · 土耳其尚勒乌尔法
san-134.intro: Göbekli Tepe is a Neolithic hilltop sanctuary built around 9500–8000 BC, older than Stonehenge and the pyramids. Circular enclosures contain massive T-shaped limestone pillars carved with animal reliefs, erected by hunter-gatherers before the invention of agriculture. The site transformed our understanding of the origins of religion and monumental architecture and was inscribed in 2018.
san-134.introZh: 哥贝克力石阵是约公元前9500至前8000年建造的新石器时代山顶圣所，比巨石阵与金字塔更为古老。圆形围栏内立有巨大的T形石灰岩柱，柱上雕刻动物浮雕，由尚未发明农业的狩猎采集者竖立。遗址改变了人们对宗教起源与纪念性建筑的认识，2018年列入世界遗产。

san-135.location: Şanlıurfa, Türkiye · 土耳其尚勒乌尔法
san-135.intro: Balıklıgöl is a pair of sacred carp pools in the centre of Şanlıurfa, associated with the prophet Abraham, who is said to have been thrown into a fire here and saved by God, the flames turning to water and the logs to fish. The surrounding park, Halilürrahman Mosque and cave of Abraham make it a major pilgrimage and family destination.
san-135.introZh: 巴尔勒克勒湖是尚勒乌尔法市中心的两座圣鱼池，传说先知亚伯拉罕被投入火中，蒙神拯救，火焰化为水、木柴化为鱼。周边公园、哈利勒·拉赫曼清真寺与亚伯拉罕洞穴使其成为重要朝圣地与家庭出游热点。

san-136.location: Harran, Şanlıurfa, Türkiye · 土耳其尚勒乌尔法哈兰
san-136.intro: Harran is an ancient city of the Mesopotamian plain, mentioned in the Bible and famous for its beehive-shaped mud-brick houses that stay cool in summer. Its ruins include a university, mosque and city walls, and the site was a centre of astronomy and learning in the medieval period. The traditional village life nearby is part of the attraction.
san-136.introZh: 哈兰是美索不达米亚平原上的古城，《圣经》中曾有记载，以夏季凉爽的蜂巢形土坯房屋闻名。遗址包括大学、清真寺与城墙，中世纪时曾是天文与学术中心。附近的传统村落生活也是吸引力的一部分。

san-137.location: Şanlıurfa, Türkiye · 土耳其尚勒乌尔法
san-137.intro: Şanlıurfa's covered bazaar is a lively network of lanes selling spices, textiles, copper and local sweets, with hans and tea houses tucked between the shops. The city is one of Türkiye's great food destinations, known for çiğ köfte, kebab, liver dishes and pistachio sweets. Eating here is as much a cultural experience as visiting the monuments.
san-137.introZh: 尚勒乌尔法的室内巴扎由热闹的街巷组成，出售香料、纺织品、铜器与地方甜点，店铺之间藏着客栈与茶馆。城市是土耳其重要美食目的地，以生肉丸、烤肉、肝类菜肴与开心果甜点闻名。在这里用餐与参观古迹同样是一种文化体验。

san-138.location: Gaziantep, Türkiye · 土耳其加济安泰普
san-138.intro: The Zeugma Mosaic Museum houses the spectacular mosaics rescued from the Roman city of Zeugma before it was flooded by a dam reservoir. Its galleries display the famous Gypsy Girl mosaic, ocean and mythological scenes, and reconstructions of Roman villas. It is one of the largest mosaic museums in the world and the highlight of Gaziantep.
san-138.introZh: 泽乌玛马赛克博物馆收藏了在罗马古城泽乌玛被水库淹没前抢救出的大量精美马赛克。展厅陈列著名的“吉普赛少女”马赛克、海洋与神话场景，以及罗马别墅复原。它是世界上最大的马赛克博物馆之一，也是加济安泰普的亮点。

san-139.location: Gaziantep, Türkiye · 土耳其加济安泰普
san-139.intro: Gaziantep Castle occupies a hilltop mound with Roman, Byzantine and Ottoman layers, and its museum tells the story of the city's defense in the Turkish War of Independence. Below, the Bakırcılar bazaar is a working quarter of copper smiths, spice sellers and sweet shops. The city is also famous for its pistachio baklava and kebabs.
san-139.introZh: 加济安泰普城堡坐落于层叠着罗马、拜占庭与奥斯曼遗迹的山丘上，博物馆讲述城市在土耳其独立战争中的保卫战。城堡下方的铜匠市场是仍在运转的街区，聚集铜器匠人、香料商与甜品店。城市还以开心果果仁蜜饼与烤肉闻名。

san-140.location: Mardin, Türkiye · 土耳其马尔丁
san-140.intro: Mardin's old town climbs a hillside above the Mesopotamian plain in terraces of honey-coloured stone houses, mosques, churches and monasteries. Its lanes, hans and bazaar reflect a mix of Kurdish, Arab, Turkish and Syriac Christian heritage, and the view from the citadel at sunset is unforgettable. The city is one of the most atmospheric in Türkiye.
san-140.introZh: 马尔丁老城沿山坡层叠而上，蜜色石屋、清真寺、教堂与修道院俯瞰美索不达米亚平原。街巷、客栈与巴扎折射出库尔德、阿拉伯、土耳其与叙利亚基督教传统的交融，日落时从城堡眺望的景色令人难忘。这里是土耳其最具氛围的城市之一。

san-141.location: Mardin, Türkiye · 土耳其马尔丁
san-141.intro: Deyrulzafaran is a working Syriac Orthodox monastery founded in the fifth century, set among olive groves east of Mardin. Its name means "monastery of saffron", and the complex includes churches, chapels, a cemetery and a sun temple beneath the main building. It remains the seat of the Syriac Orthodox Archbishop of Mardin.
san-141.introZh: 德伊鲁尔扎法兰是建于5世纪的叙利亚东正教修道院，位于马尔丁以东的橄榄园中，至今仍有修士生活。其名意为“番红花修道院”，建筑群包括教堂、小礼拜堂、墓地以及主楼下的太阳神庙。这里仍是马尔丁叙利亚东正教大主教的驻地。

san-142.location: Midyat, Mardin, Türkiye · 土耳其马尔丁米迪亚特
san-142.intro: Midyat is a stone town at the heart of Tur Abdin, the historic homeland of the Syriac Orthodox Church, famous for silver filigree and stone architecture. Its old quarter and surrounding villages contain ancient monasteries and churches, some still in use. The region offers a rare window into the living heritage of Syriac Christianity in Anatolia.
san-142.introZh: 米迪亚特是图尔阿布丁核心地带的石造小镇，这一地区是叙利亚东正教的历史家园，以银丝细工与石建筑闻名。老城与周边村落保存着古老修道院与教堂，部分仍在使用。该地区为了解安纳托利亚叙利亚基督教的活态遗产提供了难得窗口。

san-143.location: Hasankeyf, Batman, Türkiye · 土耳其巴特曼哈桑凯伊夫
san-143.intro: Hasankeyf was an ancient town on the Tigris, with a cliff-top castle, cave dwellings and medieval bridges. Much of the lower town and its monuments were relocated or submerged after the Ilısu Dam reservoir filled in 2019–2020, and the new town sits above the water. The castle and some monuments remain, offering a sobering view of heritage and development.
san-143.introZh: 哈桑凯伊夫是底格里斯河畔的古城，拥有崖顶城堡、洞穴居所与中世纪桥梁。伊利苏大坝于2019至2020年蓄水后，下城大部分建筑被迁移或淹没，新城建在水面之上。城堡与部分古迹仍存，呈现遗产与开发之间的复杂现实。

san-144.location: Kahta, Adıyaman, Türkiye · 土耳其阿德亚曼卡赫塔
san-144.intro: Kahta is the gateway town for Mount Nemrut, with a castle, a Roman bridge and the Karakuş tumulus nearby. Most visitors pass through on the way to the summit, but the surrounding countryside of the Kahta river valley rewards a slower stay. The town also has a museum and lively local markets.
san-144.introZh: 卡赫塔是前往内姆鲁特山的门户小镇，附近有城堡、罗马桥与卡拉库什土丘。多数游客只是途经前往山顶，但卡赫塔河谷的乡村风光值得放慢脚步。镇上还有博物馆与热闹的本地集市。
